Erm, yes, the rift spell will open things up alright. Ahem.
So there I was working hard on getting the last pieces together for it.
Then, all of a sudden, a gang of thugs came around and started bullying me.
They said they were Messengers of the Shadow, and insisted that I should cease my spell making.
Preposterous, isn't it? I was so close to having the power!
Oh, the power I could have had. My dear rift spell.
Anyway, I was just about to finish the last piece of my rift spell when the bandits came and robbed me.
The bandits took my notes for the spell and took off before I could call the guards.
After years of work, I can't seem to remember the last parts of the spell.
Do you think you could help me locate it? Then I could have the power at last!
You will of course be suitably rewarded for your part in me getting this power.

replies.text: Very well. I will help you.
No thanks, this seems like something that I would rather not get involved with.

conversationlist_fallhaven_vacor.message: I knew I couldn't trust... Wait, what? You actually said yes? Hah, well then.
OK, find the four pieces of my rift spell that the bandits took, and bring the pieces to me.
There were four bandits, and they all headed south of Fallhaven after I was attacked.
You should search the southern parts of Fallhaven for the four bandits.
Please hurry! I am so eager to open up the rift ... erm, I mean finish the spell. Nothing odd with that right?
Hello again. How is the search for my missing pieces of the rift spell going?

replies.text: I have found all the pieces.
What was I supposed to do again?
Could you tell me the whole story again?

conversationlist_fallhaven_vacor.message: Oh, you found all four pieces? Hurry, give them to me.
Yes, these are the pieces that the bandits took.
Now I should be able to finish the rift spell and open up the Shadow rift ... erm I mean open up new possibilities. Yes, that's what I meant.
The only obstacle between me and continuing my rift spell research is that stupid Unzel fellow.
Unzel was my apprentice a while ago. But he started to annoy me with his questions and talk about morality.
He said that my spell making was disrupting the will of the Shadow.
Bah, the Shadow. What has it ever done for ME?!
I shall one day cast my rift spell and we will be rid of the Shadow.
Anyway. I have a feeling that Unzel sent those bandits after me, and if I don't stop him he will probably send more.
I need you to find Unzel and kill him for me. He can probably be found somewhere southwest of Fallhaven.
Bring me his signet ring as proof when you have killed him.
Now hurry, I cannot wait much longer. The power shall be MINE!
Hello again. Any progress yet?

replies.text: Could you tell me the story again?

conversationlist_fallhaven_vacor.message: Have you killed Unzel for me yet? Bring me his signet ring when you have killed him.

replies.text: I have dealt with him. Here is his ring.
I listened to Unzel's story and have decided to side with him. The Shadow must be preserved.

conversationlist_fallhaven_vacor.message: Ha ha, Unzel is dead! That pathetic creature is gone!
I can see the blood on your boots. I even got you to kill his minions beforehand.
This is a great day indeed. I will soon have the power!
Here, have these coins for your help.
Now leave me, I have work to do before I can cast the rift spell.
Hello again, my assassin friend. I will soon have my rift spell ready.
What? He told you his story? You actually believed it?
I will give you one more chance. Either kill Unzel for me, and I will reward you handsomely, or you will have to fight me.

replies.text: OK, I'll think about it once more.

conversationlist_fallhaven_vacor.message: Bah, lowly creature. I knew I shouldn't have trusted you. Now you will die along with your precious Shadow.

conversationlist_fallhaven_unzel.message: Hello. I'm Unzel.

replies.text: I am sent by Vacor to kill you.

conversationlist_fallhaven_unzel.message: Yes, this is my camp. Lovely place, isn't it?
Vacor sent you huh? I guess I should have figured he would send someone sooner or later.
Very well then. Kill me if you must, or allow me to tell you my side of the story.

replies.text: Hah, I will enjoy killing you!
I will listen to your story.

conversationlist_fallhaven_unzel.message: Very well, let's fight then.
Thank you for listening.
Vacor and I used to travel together, but he started to get obsessed with his spell making.
He even started to question the Shadow. I knew I had to do something to stop him!
I started questioning him about what he was up to, but he just wanted to keep on going.
After a while, he became obsessed with the thought of a rift spell. He said it would grant him unlimited powers against the Shadow.
So, there was only one thing I could do. I left him and needed to stop him from trying to create the rift spell.
I sent some friends to take the spell from him.
So, here we are.

replies.text: I killed the four bandits you sent after Vacor.

conversationlist_fallhaven_unzel.message: So, here we are.
What? You killed my four friends? Argh, I feel the rage coming.
However, I also realize that all this is the making of Vacor. I'll give you a choice now. Choose wisely.
Either you side with Vacor and his rift spell, or side with the Shadow, and help me get rid of him. Who will you help?

replies.text: I will side with you. The Shadow must not be disturbed.

conversationlist_fallhaven_unzel.message: Thank you my friend. We will keep the Shadow safe from Vacor.
You should go talk to him about the Shadow.
Welcome back. Did you talk to Vacor?

replies.text: Yes, I have dealt with him.

conversationlist_fallhaven_unzel.message: You killed him? You have my thanks friend. Now we are safe from Vacor's rift spell. Here, take these coins for your help.
Thank you for your help. Now we are safe from Vacor's rift spell.

replies.text: I have a message for you from Kaverin in Remgard.

conversationlist_wilderness.message: Get lost kid. I don't have time for you.

replies.text: I'm looking for a piece of the Rift spell.

conversationlist_wilderness.message: No! Vacor will not gain the power of the rift spell!
What have we here? A lost wanderer?
How much is your life worth to you? Give me 100 gold and I'll let you go.

replies.text: OK OK. Here is the gold. Please don't hurt me!
How about we fight over it?
How much is your life worth?

conversationlist_wilderness.message: About damn time. You are free to go.
OK then, your life it is. Let's fight. I have been looking forward to a good fight!
Now the area is clean of these nasty highwaymen at last.

conversationlist_flagstone.message: Fresh flesh!

replies.text: By the Shadow, I will slay you.
Yuck, what are you? And what is that smell?

conversationlist_flagstone.message: Nooo, I will not be imprisoned again!
Aaaa! Who's there? I will not be enslaved again!
Ah, another mortal. Prepare to become part of my undead army!
Die mortal!
What, a mortal in here that is not marked by my touch?
You seem delicious and soft, will you be part of the feast?
Yes, I think you will. My undead army will spread far outside of Flagstone once I am done with you.

replies.text: By the Shadow, you must be stopped!
No! This land must be protected from the undead!

conversationlist_flagstone.message: Halt! Who's there? No one is allowed to approach Flagstone.
You should turn back while you still can.
Flagstone has been overrun by undead, and we are standing guard here to make sure no undead escape.

replies.text: Can you tell me the story about Flagstone?

conversationlist_flagstone.message: Flagstone Prison was built a few hundred years ago by house Gorland of Stoutford and used until the Noble Wars, when the house was vanquished. This dreadful place has been abandoned ever since.
For years, no one took notice of Flagstone, although there were occasional reports from travelers of terrible screams coming from the camp.
But recently, undead started pouring out of Flagstone and started to threaten Stoutford and the trade routes nearby.
So, here we are. I have to guard the road from undead, so that they do not spread farther than Flagstone.
So, I would advise you to leave unless you want to be overrun by undead.

replies.text: Can I investigate the Flagstone ruins?

conversationlist_flagstone.message: Are you really sure you want to head in there? Well, OK, fine by me.
I won't stop you, and I won't mourn you if you never return.
Go ahead. Let me know if there's anything I can tell you that would help.
Return here if you need my advice.

replies.text: OK. I will return to you if there is anything I need help with.

conversationlist_flagstone.message: Hello again. Did you enter Flagstone? I am surprised you actually returned.

replies.text: Can you tell me the story again?
There is a guardian in the lower levels of Flagstone that cannot be approached and the former prisoners are undead now.

conversationlist_flagstone.message: A guardian and undead prisoners you say? This is troubling news, since it means there is some larger force behind all this.
You should look for the former warden. Maybe he has something to do with all of this. If you find him you should return here with any important news.

replies.text: OK, I will go and look for the former warden.

conversationlist_flagstone.message: Oh this looks most interesting. Let's take a look. Hmm. It has got some weird inscriptions on it that say 'Daylight Shadow'. Maybe you could try these words on the demon? So perhaps the warden did have something to do with the demon after all?
Hello again. Have you found the former warden in Flagstone yet?

replies.text: I slew the former warden and found a peculiar necklace among his remains.
Can you tell me the story again?
Not yet. I have to keep looking.

conversationlist_flagstone.message: You found the necklace? Good. Here, give it to me.
Now, let's see here. Ah yes, it is as I thought. The necklace contains a password.
'Daylight Shadow'. That must be it. You should try to approach the guardian with this password.
Hello again. How is the investigation of the undead in Flagstone going?
Well, keep looking. Return to me if you need my advice.
Hello again. It seems something happened inside Flagstone that made the undead weaker. I'm sure we have you to thank for it.

replies.text: In the depths of Flagstone, I had to fight a winged demon and found a prisoner called Narael. He told me that he has been there for a very long time, and is too weak to leave.

conversationlist_flagstone.message: Thank you, thank you for freeing me from that monster.
I have been a captive here for what seems to be an eternity.
Oh, the things they did to me. Thank you so much for freeing me.
I was once a citizen in Nor City, during which time some men wanted to open the mines under Mt Galmore again, and like the fool that I am I signed up for the promise of riches.
After a while, the day came when I wanted to quit the assignment and return to my wife.
The officer in charge would not let me, and out of malice he threw me in a cell here in the old prison of Flagstone for disobeying his orders.
If only I could see my wife once more. I have hardly any life left in me, and I don't even have enough strength to leave this place.
I guess my fate is to perish here, but now as a free man at least.
Now leave me to my fate. I do not have the strength to leave this place.
If you find my wife Taurum in Nor City, please tell her I'm alive and that I haven't forgotten about her.

Lord Geomyr and his royal guard on the other hand, are still trying their best to rule in a way that they feel is fair.

replies.text: Why is everyone in Vilegard so afraid of outsiders?

conversationlist_vilegard_villagers.message: I don't trust you. You should go see Jolnor in the chapel if you want some sympathy.
Hello there. I heard you helped us common folk here in Vilegard. Please stay for as long as you like friend.

replies.text: Thank you. Have you seen my brother Andor around here?

conversationlist_vilegard_villagers.message: Your brother? No, I haven't seen anyone that looks like you. But then again, I never take much notice to outsiders.

conversationlist_vilegard_erttu.message: Hello there outsider. In general, we dislike outsiders here in Vilegard, but there is something about you that I find familiar.
What do you want to talk about?

replies.text: Why is everyone in Vilegard so suspicious of outsiders?
What can you tell me about Vilegard?

conversationlist_vilegard_erttu.message: Most of us that live here in Vilegard have a history of trusting people too much. People that have hurt us in the end.
Now we start by being suspicious, and ask that outsiders coming here gain our trust by helping us first.
Also, other people generally look down upon us here in Vilegard for some reason. Especially those snobs from Feygard and the northern cities.

replies.text: What else can you tell me about Vilegard?

conversationlist_vilegard_erttu.message: We have almost everything we need here in Vilegard. Our center of the village is the chapel.
The chapel serves as our place of worship for the Shadow, and also as our place to gather when discussing larger issues in our village.
Apart from the chapel, we have a tavern, a smith and an armorer.

replies.text: Thanks for the information. There was something else I wanted to talk about.
Wow, nothing more? I wonder what I am doing in a puny village such as this one.

conversationlist_vilegard_tavern.message: You look like a smart fellow. Need any supplies?

replies.text: Sure, let me see what you have available.
What can you tell me about yourself?
I spoke to Tharwyn about who her beer 'distributor' is and she sent me to you.
I spoke to Tharwyn about who her beer 'distributor' is and she sent me to you.

conversationlist_vilegard_tavern.message: Me? I am no one. You didn't even see me. You certainly did not talk to me.

replies.text: Troublemaker sent me to get your report.

conversationlist_vilegard_tavern.message: Hello there. I heard you helped Jolnor in the chapel. You have my thanks, friend.
Have a seat anywhere. What can I get you?

replies.text: Show me what food you have available.
Torilo suggested that I ask other tavern owners such as yourself about a 'business agreement' that you may have with a group of 'distributors'.
Let's get back to discussing your 'business agreement' with the 'distributors'.

conversationlist_vilegard_tavern.message: Oh look, a lost kid. Here, have some mead kid.

conversationlist_jolnor.message: Walk with the Shadow my child.

replies.text: I was told to talk to you about why everyone in Vilegard is suspicious of outsiders.

conversationlist_jolnor.message: Walk with the Shadow my child.

replies.text: Can you tell me again what this place is?
Let's talk about those missions for gaining trust that you talked about earlier.
I require healing. Can I see what items you have available?

conversationlist_jolnor.message: Walk with the Shadow my friend.

replies.text: Can you tell me again what this place is?
I require healing. Can I see what items you have available?
I need some help finding out who is responsible for casting a Shadow spell that causes a person to become noticeable.
The blessing has worn off too early. Could you give it again?

conversationlist_jolnor.message: This is Vilegard's place of worship for the Shadow. We praise the Shadow in all its might and glory.

replies.text: Can you tell me more about the Shadow?
I require healing. Can I see what items you have available?
Whatever. Just show me your goods.

conversationlist_jolnor.message: The Shadow protects us from the dangers of the night. It keeps us safe and comforts us when we sleep.
I don't trust you enough yet to feel comfortable trading with you.
Suspicious? No, I wouldn't call it suspicion. I would rather call it that we are careful nowadays.
In order to gain the trust of the village, an outsider must prove that they are not here to cause trouble.

replies.text: Sounds like a good idea. There are a lot of selfish people out there.
That sounds really unnecessary. Why not trust people in the first place?

conversationlist_jolnor.message: Yes, right. You seem to understand us well, I like that.

replies.text: Is there anything I can do to gain your trust?

conversationlist_jolnor.message: We have learned from history not to trust outsiders, and you are an outsider. Why should we trust you?

replies.text: What can I do to gain your trust?
You are right. You probably should not trust me.

conversationlist_jolnor.message: With your help earlier, you have already gained our trust.
As I said before, you have to help some people here in Vilegard to gain our trust.
If you do us a favor, we might consider trusting you. There are three people I can think of that are influential here in Vilegard, that you should try to help.
First, there is Kaori. She lives up in the northern part of Vilegard. Ask her if she wants help with anything.

replies.text: OK. Talk to Kaori. Got it.

conversationlist_jolnor.message: Then there is Wrye. Wrye also lives up in the northern part of Vilegard. Many people here in Vilegard seek her advice on various things.
She recently lost her son in a tragic way. If you can gain her trust, you will have a strong ally here.
And last but not least, I have a favor to ask of you as well.
North of Vilegard is a tavern called the Foaming Flask. In my opinion, this tavern is a guard station in guise for Feygard.
The tavern is almost always visited by the Feygard royal guard of Lord Geomyr.
They are probably here to spy on us, since we are followers of the Shadow. Lord Geomyr's forces always try to make life difficult for us and the Shadow.

replies.text: Yes, they seem like troublemakers all around.
I am sure they have their reasons for doing what they do.

conversationlist_jolnor.message: Right. Troublemakers indeed.

replies.text: What do you want me to do?

conversationlist_jolnor.message: Yes, their reason is to make life miserable for us, I am sure.

replies.text: What do you want me to do?

conversationlist_jolnor.message: My reports say that there is a guard stationed outside the tavern, to keep an eye on potential dangers.
I want you to make sure the guard disappears somehow. How you do that is purely up to you.

replies.text: I am not sure I should upset the Feygard patrol guards. This could really get me into trouble.
For the Shadow, I will do as you ask.
OK, I hope this leads to some treasure in the end.

conversationlist_jolnor.message: It's your choice. You can at least go check out the tavern and see if you find anything suspicious.
Good. Report back to me when you are done.
So, in order to gain our trust here in Vilegard, I would suggest you help Kaori, Wrye and me.

replies.text: Thank you for the information. I will be back when I have something to report.

conversationlist_jolnor.message: I would suggest you help Kaori, Wrye and me to gain our trust.

replies.text: About that guard outside the Foaming Flask tavern...
Never mind, let's get back to those other topics.

conversationlist_jolnor.message: Yes, what about them?

replies.text: What was I supposed to do again?
I have done all the tasks you asked me to do.
Never mind, let's get back to those other topics.

conversationlist_jolnor.message: Yes, what about him. Have you removed him yet?

replies.text: Yes, he will leave his post as soon as this shift is over.
No, but I am working on it.

conversationlist_jolnor.message: Yes, you dealt with him earlier. Thank you for your help.
Very good. Thank you for your help.

replies.text: No problem. Let's get back to those other tasks we talked about.

conversationlist_jolnor.message: You still need to help Kaori with her task.
You still need to help Wrye with her task.
Good. You helped all three of us.
I suppose that shows some dedication, and that we are ready to trust you now.
You have our thanks, friend. You will always find shelter here in Vilegard. We welcome you into our village.

conversationlist_alynndir.message: Hello there. Welcome to my cabin.

replies.text: What do you do around here?
What can you tell me about the surroundings here?

conversationlist_alynndir.message: Mostly, I trade with travelers on the main road on the way to Nor City.

replies.text: Do you have anything to trade?
What can you tell me about the surroundings here?

conversationlist_alynndir.message: Oh, there is not much around here. Vilegard to the west, Brightport to the east and Sullengard to the south.
Up north is just forest. But there are some strange things happening there.
I have heard terrible screams coming from the forest to the northwest.
I really wonder what is up there.

replies.text: You mentioned Sullengard. What can you tell me about it?

conversationlist_vilegard_shops.message: Hello there. Please browse my selection of fine armors and protection.

replies.text: Let me see your list of wares.

conversationlist_vilegard_shops.message: Hello there. I heard you helped us here in Vilegard. What can I help you with?

replies.text: Can I see what items you have for sale?
I have a shipment of Feygard items for you.
On the body of something called the Hira'zinn, I found this peculiar sword. Do you know anything about it?

conversationlist_vilegard_shops.message: You are an outsider. We don't like outsiders here in Vilegard. Please leave.

replies.text: Why is everyone in Vilegard so suspicious of outsiders?
Can I see what items you have for sale?

conversationlist_vilegard_shops.message: You are an outsider. We don't like outsiders here in Vilegard. Please leave.

replies.text: Why is everyone in Vilegard so suspicious of outsiders?
Can I see what items you have for sale?
I have a shipment of Feygard items for you.
On the body of something called the Hira'zinn, I found this peculiar sword. Do you know anything about it?

conversationlist_vilegard_shops.message: I don't trust you. You should go see Jolnor in the chapel if you want some sympathy.

replies.text: I was told to see you.

conversationlist_ogam.message: Backwards is the burden high and low.

replies.text: Hello? Umar in the Fallhaven Thieves' Guild sent me to see you.

conversationlist_ogam.message: Two alike in body and mind.

replies.text: Are you going to make any sense?
Hello? Do you know how I can reach Lodar's hideaway?
Are you even listening to what I say?
Hello? Do you know how I can reach Lodar's hideaway?

conversationlist_ogam.message: Lodar, halfway between the Shadow and the light. Rocky formations.

replies.text: OK, halfway between two places. Some rocks?
Glow of the Shadow? Are those the words the guardian needs to hear?
'Glow of the Shadow'? I recognize that from somewhere.

conversationlist_foamingflask.message: Hello. Do you want something from the kitchen?

replies.text: Sure, let me see what food you have to sell.
That smells horrible. What are you cooking?
That smells wonderful. What are you cooking?

conversationlist_foamingflask.message: Oh this? This is supposed to be a stew of anklebiter. Needs more seasoning I guess.

replies.text: I look forward to trying it when it is done. Good luck cooking.
Yuck, that sounds awful. Can you really eat those things? I'm grossed out, goodbye.

conversationlist_foamingflask.message: No sorry, I don't have any food to sell. Go talk to Torilo over there if you want some drink or ready-made food.
Welcome to the Foaming Flask tavern. We welcome all travelers in here.

replies.text: Thank you. Are you the innkeeper here?
Have you seen a boy called Rincel around here recently?
Hey, I noticted all of those beer barrels outside and all those drunk guards over there.

conversationlist_foamingflask.message: I am Torilo, the proprietor of this establishment. Please have a seat anywhere you like.

replies.text: Can I see what you have available for food and drink?
Do you have somewhere I can rest?
Are those guards always shouting and yelling that much?

conversationlist_foamingflask.message: Was there anything else you wanted?

replies.text: Can I see what you have available for food and drink?
Are those guards always shouting and yelling that much?
Have you seen a boy called Rincel around here recently?

conversationlist_foamingflask.message: Absolutely. We have a wide selection of food and beverages.
Yes, you already rented the back room.
Please feel free to use it in any way you like. I hope you can get some sleep even with these guards yelling their songs.
Oh yes. We have a very comfortable back room here in the Foaming Flask tavern.
Available for only 250 gold. Then you can use it as much as you like.

replies.text: 250 gold? Sure, that's nothing to me. Here you go.
250 gold is a lot, but I guess it is worth it. Here you go.
That sounds a bit too much for me.

conversationlist_foamingflask.message: Thank you. The room is now rented to you.
Rincel? No, not that I can recall. Actually, we don't get many children in here. *chuckle*
*Sigh* Yes. Those guards have been here for quite some time now.
They seem to be looking for something or someone, but I am not sure who or what.
I hope the Shadow watches over us so that nothing bad happens to the Foaming Flask tavern because of them.

conversationlist_ambelie.message: Oh my, a commoner. Get away from me. I might catch something.

replies.text: What is a noble woman such as yourself doing in a place like this?
I would be glad to get away from a snob like you.

conversationlist_ambelie.message: I am Ambelie of the house of Laumwill in Feygard. I am sure you must have heard of me and my house.

replies.text: Oh yes ... um ... House of Laumwill in Feygard. Of course.
I have never heard of you or your house.

conversationlist_ambelie.message: Feygard, the great city of peace. Surely you must know of it. Northwest in our great land.

replies.text: What is a noble woman such as yourself doing in a place like this?
No, I have never heard of it.

conversationlist_ambelie.message: Pfft. That just proves everything I have heard of you savages here in the southern land. So uneducated.
I, Ambelie, of the house of Laumwill in Feygard, am on an excursion to the southern Nor City.
An excursion to see if Nor City really is all that I have heard about it. If it really can compare itself to the glamour of the great city of Feygard.

replies.text: If you like it so much in Feygard, why would you even leave?
Ehh ... I'm here to ... escort you safely to Nor City.

conversationlist_ambelie.message: Don't you know of Nor City? I will take note that the savages here haven't even heard of the city.
I am beginning to be even more certain that Nor City will never, even in my wildest dreams, be comparable to the great city of Feygard.
All the noblewomen in Feygard keep talking about the mysterious Shadow in Nor City. I just have to see it myself.
Thank you. Now please leave before someone sees me talking to a commoner like you.

replies.text: Commoner? Are you trying to insult me? Goodbye.
Whatever, you probably wouldn't even survive a forest wasp.

conversationlist_foamingflask_guards.message: Ha ha, you tell him Garl! *burp*
Sing, drink, fight! All who oppose Feygard will fall!
We will stand tall. Feygard, city of peace!

replies.text: Have you seen a boy called Rincel around here recently?

conversationlist_foamingflask_guards.message: What, you haven't heard of Feygard, kid? Just follow the road northwest and you will see the great city of Feygard rise above the treetops.
A boy?! Apart from you, there have been no children in here that I have seen.
Check with the captain over there. He has been around here for longer than us.

replies.text: Thank you. Shadow be with you.

conversationlist_foamingflask_guards.message: Don't bring that cursed Shadow in here son. We want none of that. Now leave.
Are you lost, son? This is no place for a kid like you.

replies.text: I have a shipment of iron swords from Gandoren for you.
I have a shipment of iron swords from Gandoren for you.
Have you seen a boy called Rincel around here recently?
Hi! I have been sent by Herg ... Hertzsen Laumwill, patriarch of the Laumwill family, to bring back his daughter!
Let's talk about the beer investigation.

conversationlist_foamingflask_guards.message: I am the guard captain of this patrol. We hail from the great city of Feygard.

replies.text: What do you do around here?

conversationlist_foamingflask_guards.message: We are travelling the main road to make sure the merchants and travelers are safe. We keep the peace around here.

replies.text: You mentioned Feygard. Where is that?

conversationlist_foamingflask_guards.message: The great city of Feygard is the greatest sight you will ever see. Follow the road northwest.

replies.text: Thank you. Shadow be with you.

conversationlist_foamingflask_guards.message: There was a kid running around in here a while ago.
I never talked to him though, so I don't know if he is the one you are looking for.

replies.text: OK, that might be something worth checking anyway.

conversationlist_foamingflask_guards.message: I noticed he left to the west heading out of the Foaming Flask tavern.

replies.text: West. Got it. Thanks for the information.

conversationlist_foamingflask_guards.message: Always happy to help. Anything for the glory of Feygard.
The Shadow? Don't tell me you believe in that stuff. In my experience, only troublemakers talk of the Shadow.

conversationlist_foamingflask_outsidegua.message: Hello there. Should you be here? This is a tavern, you know. The Foaming Flask, to be precise.
I am a member of the royal guard patrol from Feygard.

replies.text: What do you do around here?

conversationlist_foamingflask_outsidegua.message: Go talk to the captain inside if you want to talk. I must stay alert on my post.

replies.text: Why must you stay alert outside a tavern?

conversationlist_foamingflask_outsidegua.message: Really, I cannot talk to you. I could get into trouble.

replies.text: OK. I won't bother you anymore. Shadow be with you.
OK. I won't bother you anymore. Goodbye.

conversationlist_foamingflask_outsidegua.message: No really, the captain might see me. I must be aware on my post at all times. *sigh*

replies.text: OK. I won't bother you anymore. Shadow be with you.
OK. I won't bother you anymore. Goodbye.
Do you like your job here?

conversationlist_foamingflask_outsidegua.message: My job? I guess the royal guard is OK. I mean, Feygard is a really nice place to live in.
Standing guard on duty out here in the middle of nowhere is not really what I signed up for.

replies.text: I bet. This place is really boring.
You must get tired of just standing here also.

conversationlist_foamingflask_outsidegua.message: Yeah I know. I would rather be inside in the tavern drinking like the senior officers and the captain. How come I have to stand out here?

replies.text: At least the Shadow watches over you.
Why not just leave if it's not what you want to do?
The greater cause of the royal guard, to keep the peace, is worth it in the long run.

conversationlist_foamingflask_outsidegua.message: Yes, you are right of course. Our duty is to Feygard and to keep the peace from all that want to disrupt it.

replies.text: Yes. The Shadow will not look favorably upon those that disrupt the peace.
Yes. The troublemakers should be punished.

conversationlist_foamingflask_outsidegua.message: No, my loyalty is to Feygard. If I would leave, I would also leave my loyalty behind.

replies.text: What does that mean if you are not satisfied with what you do?
Yes, that sounds right. Feygard sounds like a nice place from what I have heard.

conversationlist_foamingflask_outsidegua.message: Right. I like you, kid. Tell you what, I could put in a good word for you in the barracks when we get back to Feygard if you want.

replies.text: Sure, that sounds good to me.
No thanks. I have enough to do already.

conversationlist_foamingflask_outsidegua.message: Well, I am convinced that we must follow the laws laid down by our rulers. If we don't obey the law, what are we left with?

Chaos. Disorder.

No, I prefer the lawful way of Feygard. My loyalty is firm.

replies.text: Sounds good to me. Laws are made to be followed.
I do not agree. We should follow our heart, even if that goes against the rules.

conversationlist_foamingflask_outsidegua.message: Was there anything else you wanted?

replies.text: I was wondering about why you stand guard here.

conversationlist_foamingflask_outsidegua.message: That troubles me. We might see each other again in the future. But then we might not be able to have this kind of civil discussion.
Right, we went over this before. As I said, I would rather be inside by the fire.

replies.text: I could spot for you if you want to go inside.
Tough luck. I guess you are left out here, while your captain and buddies are inside.

conversationlist_foamingflask_outsidegua.message: Yeah, that's just my luck.

Thanks a lot my friend.

replies.text: I did not mean a thing by it. Never mind I said anything.
The Shadow watches over us when we sleep.

conversationlist_foamingflask_outsidegua.message: Good. Now be gone before I will have to deal with you.

replies.text: Fine. I better not start a fight with the royal guard.

conversationlist_foamingflask_outsidegua.message: That does it. You better fight or flee right now kid.

replies.text: Good. I have been waiting for a fight!

replies.text: Yes, I came back to deliver your order of a 'Lyre'. You must be good at playing it?

conversationlist_wrye.message: Shadow help me.

replies.text: Excuse me, I'm here to deliver your order for a 'Lyre'.

conversationlist_wrye.message: My son! My son is gone.

conversationlist_wrye.message: I don't want to talk about it. Not with an outsider like you.

replies.text: Jolnor said I should see you about your son.

conversationlist_wrye.message:
Please leave me.

My son is dead, I know it! And it's those damn guards fault. Those guards with their snobby Feygard attitude.
At first they come with promises of protection and power. But then you really start to see them for what they are.
I can feel it in me. The Shadow speaks to me. He is dead.

replies.text: Can you tell me what happened?

conversationlist_wrye.message: Thank you. Shadow watch over me.
It all started with those Feygard royal guards coming here.
They tried to pressure everyone in Vilegard into recruiting more soldiers.
The guards would say they needed more support to help squelch the supposed uprising and sabotage.

replies.text: How did this relate to your son?
Are you going to get to the point soon?

conversationlist_wrye.message: My son, Rincel, did not seem to care much for the stories they told.
I also told Rincel of how bad an idea I thought it was to recruit more people to the Royal Guard.
The guards stayed a couple of days to talk to everyone here in Vilegard. Then they left. They went to the next town I guess.
A few days passed, and then suddenly my boy Rincel was gone one day. I am sure those guards managed to somehow persuade him to join them.
Oh how I despise those evil and snobby Feygard bastards.
This was several weeks ago. Now I feel an emptiness inside. I know in me that something has happened to my son Rincel.
I fear he has died or got hurt somehow. Those bastards probably drove him into his own death.
*sob* Shadow help me.

replies.text: What can I do to help?
That sounds awful. I am sure you are just imagining things.
Do you have proof that the people from Feygard are involved?

conversationlist_wrye.message: No, but I know it in me that they are. The Shadow speaks to me.

replies.text: OK. Is there anything I can do to help?
You sound a bit too occupied with the Shadow. I want no part of this.
I probably shouldn't get involved in this if it means that I could upset the royal guard.

conversationlist_wrye.message: If you want to help me, please find out what happened to my son, Rincel.

replies.text: Any idea where I should look?

conversationlist_wrye.message: Please return here as soon as you have found out anything.

replies.text: By the Shadow, your son will be avenged.

OK. I will go look for your son so that you may know what happened to him.

conversationlist_wrye.message: Please tell me what happened to him!

conversationlist_wrye.message: I don't believe it.

replies.text: He had secretly longed to go to Feygard, but didn't dare tell you.

conversationlist_wrye.message: Attacked?

conversationlist_wrye.message: My dear boy.

replies.text: I talked to a man that found him bleeding to death.

conversationlist_wrye.message: He was still alive?

replies.text: Yes, but not for long. He did not survive the wounds. He is now buried to the northwest of Vilegard.

conversationlist_wrye.message: Oh my poor boy. What have I done?

And now he is not with us anymore.
Thank you, friend, for finding out what happened to him and telling me the truth.
Oh my poor boy.

conversationlist_oluag.message: Hello. I am Oluag.

conversationlist_oluag.message: Well, when I say 'nothing', I really mean nothing. Or maybe just a little bit.

replies.text: Do I have to beat it out of you?

conversationlist_oluag.message: Relax, relax. I don't want any more fights.

So I buried him over there by that grave.

replies.text: What were the last sentences you heard him say?

conversationlist_oluag.message: Something about Vilegard and Ryndel maybe? I didn't really pay attention, I was more interested in what loot he had on him.

replies.text: I should go check that grave. Goodbye.
Rincel, was that it? From Vilegard? Wrye's missing son.

conversationlist_oluag.message: Yeah, that might be it. Anyway, so he said something about fulfilling a dream to see the great city of Feygard.
And he told me something about that he didn't dare tell anyone.

replies.text: Maybe he didn't dare tell Wrye?

conversationlist_oluag.message: Yeah sure, probably. He had set down here to camp, but got attacked by some monsters.
Apparently he was not as strong a fighter as, for example, someone like me. So the monsters wounded him too much for him to last the night.
Sadly, they also must have taken any loot with them, since I could not find any on him.
I heard the fighting and only managed to get to him after the monsters had fled.
So, anyway. Now he is buried over there. Rest in peace.
Lousy kid. He could at least have had a few coins on him.

replies.text: Thank you for the story. Goodbye.
Thank you for the story. Shadow be with you.

conversationlist_signs_v068.message: You must rent the room before you may enter it.

The sign says:
Welcome to Vilegard, the friendliest town around.
Welcome to the Foaming Flask tavern!

North: Loneford
East: Nor City
West: Fallhaven

North: Loneford
East: Nor City
South: Vilegard
You see a recently dug grave.

North: Leofric's Honey Haven
East: Nor City
West: Vilegard

conversationlist_maelveon.message: [You feel a tingling sensation in your body as the frightening figure begins to speak]
A ... llow the Sssshadow in you.

replies.text: The Shadow, what do you mean?
I will not be affected by your nonsense!

conversationlist_maelveon.message: [The figure lifts his hand and points at you]

conversationlist_bwm_agent_1.message: Oh, someone from the outside! Please, adventurer, you have to help us!
We urgently need help from someone outside!
Very funny. I was sent by my settlement to get help from the outside.
The people of my settlement, the Blackwater mountain, are slowly being reduced in numbers by the monsters and the savage bandits.
The monsters are closing in on us, and we desperately need help by some able fighter.

replies.text: I guess I could help, I have killed a few monsters here and there.
Will there be a reward for this?
Hmm, no. I had better not get involved in this.

conversationlist_bwm_agent_1.message: Reward? Hmm, I was hoping you would help us for other reasons than a reward. But I guess my master will reward you sufficiently if you survive.
Excellent. The Blackwater mountain settlement is some distance away. Frankly, I am amazed that I made it this far alive.
I must warn you though, that there are some nasty monsters on the way.
But I guess you seem strong enough.
Good. First though, we must cross this mine to the other side.
The mine shaft over there [points] has collapsed, so I guess you won't make it through there.
You will have to go through the abandoned mine below. Beware that the mine is pitch-black, so you will have to navigate in there without any light.

replies.text: OK, I'll go through the pitch-black mine.

conversationlist_bwm_agent_1.message: I'll try to crawl back through the mine shaft here. That's how I got here in the first place.
Let's meet at the other side of this mine shaft.

replies.text: OK. You crawl through the shaft, and I'll go below. See you on the other side!

conversationlist_bwm_agent_2.message: Hello again. You made it through alive, well done!

replies.text: You never told me it would be pitch-black down there. I almost got killed!

conversationlist_bwm_agent_2.message: The gornauds? I have no idea where they come from, one day they just showed up here around the mountain.
Anyway, let's get going now. We are now one step closer to the Blackwater mountain settlement.
Once we exit this mine, it is very important that you go directly east from there. Do not travel to other places other than going east now!

replies.text: OK, I'll go east once I have exited the mine. Got it.
Why east? What else is there here?

conversationlist_bwm_agent_2.message:
I'll wait for you by the steps up to the mountain pass. See you there!

Remember, go east once you exit the mine.
Oh, nothing. There are dangerous places here. You should definitely not head any other direction than east.

replies.text: Dangerous? Sounds like my kind of place!
Is there something you are not telling me?

conversationlist_bwm_agent_2.message: It would be your loss. Don't say I didn't warn you. Safest route would be to head east.

replies.text: Is there something you are not telling me?

conversationlist_bwm_agent_2.message: No no, just head east and I'll explain everything to you once we get to the Blackwater mountain settlement.

replies.text: OK, I promise to head east once we exit the mine.
[Lie] OK, I promise to head east once we exit the mine.

conversationlist_bwm_agent_2.message: Actually, I did tell you that it would be pitch-black down there. Good work navigating through there!

conversationlist_bwm_agent_3.message: Hello. You made it here, good.

replies.text: I talked to some people in the village Prim. They had some interesting things to say about Blackwater mountain.
I went east, as you said.

conversationlist_bwm_agent_3.message: Good. Now let's get up this mountain. I will meet you halfway up there.
This path leads up to the Blackwater mountain settlement. Follow this path and we will talk later.
Beware of the nasty monsters, they can really cause some harm!

replies.text: OK, I will follow this path up the mountain.
Great, more monsters. Just what I needed.

conversationlist_bwm_agent_3.message: Do not listen to their lies. They poison your thoughts and would not hesitate to stab you in the back once they get the chance.

replies.text: Yes, they do seem a bit shady.

conversationlist_bwm_agent_3.message: I will not talk of them now. Follow me up to the Blackwater mountain settlement and we will talk more there.

replies.text: I'm keeping my eye on you. But I'll agree to your terms for now.

conversationlist_bwm_agent_4.message: Hello again. Well done defeating the gornaud beasts.

replies.text: Their attacks really hurt. What are these things?
How come they do not attack you?
Yeah, no problem. Just another trail of dead bodies behind me.

conversationlist_bwm_agent_4.message: Careful what you wish for, for it may come true.
Me? There must be something about me that scares them. I have no idea what it would be, some scent perhaps?
Anyway, we should get going. I'll run ahead of you up the mountain.
Meet me further up the mountain, and we will talk more.
I do not know where they come from. All I know is that they started to appear one day, blocking the path up the mountain.
And, their attacks are tough. Once one of them gets a hold of you, the other ones seem really eager to hit you too.

replies.text: How come they do not attack you?

conversationlist_bwm_agent_5.message: Hello again. Well done getting through those monsters.
We are almost there now. Just a little bit more.
We should hurry this last bit, my settlement is close now.
I hope you can manage the cold out here.
Also, stay away from the wyrms. They have a really nasty bite.
Now hurry. We are almost there. Follow the snowy path to the north, and you should reach the settlement in no time.

replies.text: OK, I will follow the path to the north, further up the mountain.

conversationlist_bwm_agent_6.message: I am glad you followed me up the mountain to help us out.

replies.text: How did you get up here so fast?
Those were some tough fights, but I can manage.

conversationlist_bwm_agent_6.message: Oh yes. In fact, our Blackwater mountain settlement is just down these stairs.
Go ahead, I will meet you inside.
We meet again. Well done fighting your way up here.
You should go down these stairs and talk to our battle master, Harlenn. He can usually be found at the third level down.
Yes, you seem like an able fighter.
I learned some shortcuts up and down the mountain a while back. Nothing strange about that right?
Anyway, we are right at the settlement now. In fact, our Blackwater mountain settlement is just down these stairs.

conversationlist_prim_arghest.message: Hello there.

replies.text: Did you rent the back room at the inn in Prim?

conversationlist_prim_arghest.message: This is the old Elm mine of Prim.
We used to mine a lot here. But that was before the attacks started.
The attacks on Prim by the beasts, the bandits and the disappearances really reduced our numbers. Now we cannot keep up the mining activity any longer.
I am Arghest. I guard the entrance here to make sure no one enters the old mine.
No. The mine is closed.
I said no. Visitors are not allowed in there.
Welcome back. Thanks for your help earlier. I hope the room at the inn can be of use to you.
Welcome back. Did you bring me the 5 bottles of milk that I requested?

replies.text: No, not yet. I'm working on it.
Yes, but this nearly cost me a fortune!

conversationlist_prim_arghest.message: OK then. Return to me once you have them.
Thank you my friend! Now I can restock my supply.
These bottles look excellent. Now I can last a while longer in here.
Oh, and about the room in the inn - you are welcome to use it in any way you see fit. Quite a cozy place to rest if you ask me.

replies.text: Finally, I thought I would never be able to rest here!

conversationlist_prim_arghest.message: 'Inn in Prim' - you sound funny.
Yes, I rent it. I stay there to rest when my shift ends.
However, now that we guards aren't as plentiful as we used to be, it has been a while since I could rest in there.

replies.text: Mind if I use the room at the inn to rest in?
Are you still going to use it?

conversationlist_prim_arghest.message: Well, I would like to still keep the option of using it. But I guess someone else could rest there now that I'm not actively using it.
Tell you what, if you bring me some more supplies to keep me occupied here, I guess you could have my permission to use it even though I have rented it.
I have plenty of meat here, but I ran out of milk some weeks ago. Do you think you could help me restock my milk supply?

replies.text: Sure, no problem. I'll get you your bottles of milk. How much do you need?
Sure, if it leads to me being able to rest here. I'm in.

conversationlist_prim_arghest.message: Bring me 5 bottles of milk. That should be enough.

conversationlist_prim_outside.message: Hello again. Have you spoken to Guthbered in the Prim main hall yet?

replies.text: No, not yet. Where can I find him?
Yes, he told me the story about Prim.
No, and I do not intend to speak to him either. I am on an urgent mission to help the Blackwater mountain settlement.

conversationlist_prim_outside.message: You there! Please you have to help us!

replies.text: Is this the Blackwater mountain settlement?
Sorry, I cannot be bothered right now. I was told to go east quickly.

conversationlist_prim_outside.message: Blackwater? No no, certainly not. Just over there is the village of Prim.
Blackwater mountain, those vicious bastards.
East? But that leads up to Blackwater mountain.
You really do not want to go up there.
We desperately need help from someone from the outside in our village of Prim.
You should speak to Guthbered, in the Prim main hall, just north of here.

replies.text: OK, I will go see him.
I was told to go directly east.

conversationlist_prim_outside.message: Good, thanks. We really need your help!
The village of Prim is just north of here. You can probably see it through the trees over there.

replies.text: OK, I will go there right away.

conversationlist_prim_outside.message: Do not listen to their lies!
Stay away. This is my hiding spot.

replies.text: Do you know anything about the accident with Lorn?
Do you know anything about the accident with Lorn?

conversationlist_prim_outside.message: Claws, beasts, gornauds. They cannot reach me here.

replies.text: 'Gornauds', is that what those monsters outside the village are called?
Yeah sure. Stay here and hide you pathetic creature.

conversationlist_prim_outside.message: Me? I am Moyra.
You are mean! I don't want to talk to you any more.
Please, not so loud! They could hear you.
I have seen them on the path up the mountain. Sharpening their claws.
I hide here now, so they cannot get to me.
Hello there. Welcome to Prim. Are you here to help us?

replies.text: Yes, I am here to help your village.
[Lie] Yes, I am here to help your village.
Maybe, but first tell me what do you know about Lorn's crew accident?

conversationlist_prim_outside.message: Thank you. We really need your help.
You should speak to Guthbered if you haven't done so already.
He is in the main hall right over there. The large stone house.
Hi, you seem to be new around here. How can I help you?

replies.text: Is there some place I can rest around here?
Where can I find a trader around here?

conversationlist_prim_outside.message: You should be able to find some place to rest in the inn right over there to the southeast.

replies.text: Where can I find a trader around here?

conversationlist_prim_outside.message: Our armorer is in the house in the southwest corner. I should warn you that the supply is not what it used to be though.

replies.text: Is there some place I can rest around here?

conversationlist_prim_outside.message: Hello. Welcome to Prim.

replies.text: Do you know anything about Lorn's accident?
Thank you for the hints, bye.

conversationlist_prim_outside.message: Hello. Who are you? Are you here to help us?

replies.text: I am looking for my brother. Would you by any chance have happened to see him around here?
Yes, I have come to help your village.
[Lie] Yes, I have come to help your village.
What do you know about Lorn's accident?

conversationlist_prim_outside.message: Your brother? Son, you should know that we do not get many visitors around here.
So, no. I cannot help you.
Oh thank you. We could really use some help around here.

conversationlist_prim_inn.message: You are not allowed to enter here.
Hello. I am Laecca, mountain guide.

replies.text: What do you do around here?

conversationlist_prim_inn.message: I keep an eye on the mountain pass, to make sure no more of those beasts make their way down here.

replies.text: Then what are you doing indoors here? Shouldn't you be outside guarding then?
What beasts are you talking about?

conversationlist_prim_inn.message: Yeah, sure. It may sound that way. In reality, it's a lot of hard work.
Very funny. I have to rest too you know. Keeping the monsters away is hard work.
There used to be more of us mountain guides, but not many have survived the attack of the beasts.

replies.text: Sounds like you aren't really cut out to do your job properly.
What beasts are you talking about?

conversationlist_prim_inn.message: Perhaps.
Anyway. I have some things to tend to. Nice talking to you.
Thank you for your concern.

replies.text: Is there anything I can do to help?

conversationlist_prim_inn.message: Pfft, 'What beasts?'. The gornaud beasts of course.
Scratching their claws against the bare rock at night. *shrug*
At first, I thought they were acting on pure instinct. But recently, I have started to believe they are smarter than regular beasts.
Their attacks are getting more and more clever.

replies.text: Is there anything I can do to help?

conversationlist_prim_inn.message: You should talk to Guthbered. He is usually in the main hall. Look for a stone house in the center of the village.
Can I help you?

replies.text: What food do you have available for trade?
Is the back room available for rent?

conversationlist_prim_inn.message: Food? No, sorry. I don't have anything to trade.
Rent? Hmm. No, not at the moment.
Now that you mention it, he hasn't been around here for quite some time. Maybe you could go talk to him and see if he still wants to rent it?

replies.text: OK, I will go talk to him.
Sure. Any idea where he might be?

conversationlist_prim_inn.message: It is still rented out to Arghest. He would not be very happy if I rented it out to someone else when he expects to use it.
I don't know where he is now, but I do know that he used to be part of the mining effort in our mine to the southwest.

replies.text: Thanks. I will go look for him.
I will go look for him right away.

conversationlist_prim_inn.message: Thanks.
Thank you for your help earlier. I hope the back room is comfortable enough.
Did you talk to Arghest?

replies.text: [Lie] Yes, he told me that I could rest in the back room if I want to.
Yes, he gave me permission to use the back room whenever I wish.

conversationlist_prim_inn.message: Return to me once you know if he is still interested in renting the back room or not.

replies.text: Any idea where he might be?

conversationlist_prim_inn.message: Did he really say that? Somehow I doubt that. It doesn't sound like him.
You will have to do something more to convince me.
Really, he did? Well then, go ahead. I'm just glad the back room is being used.
You are welcome to rest in the back room any time you want. Please let me know if there is anything I can do to help.
Lovely place this, isn't it?

conversationlist_prim_tavern.message: Welcome to my tavern. Please have a seat anywhere.

replies.text: What can I get to drink around here?

conversationlist_prim_tavern.message: Well, unfortunately, with the mine tunnel collapsed, we cannot trade much with the outside villages.
However, I do have a huge supply of mead that I stocked up on before the mine shaft collapsed.

replies.text: Mead? Yuck. Too sweet for my taste.
Alright! Just my kind of taste. Let's see what you have to trade.
Very well, it will have to do. I guess it has some healing potential. Let's trade.

conversationlist_prim_tavern.message: Suit yourself. That's what I've got anyway.
Oh, a new one around here.
Welcome kid. Are you here to drench your sorrows like the rest of us?

replies.text: Not really. What is there to do around here?
Yeah, give me some of what you're having.
Stop bumping into me when I'm trying to walk.

conversationlist_prim_tavern.message: My my, a feisty one. Very well, I will get out of your way.

replies.text: I should have seen that one coming. Goodbye.

conversationlist_prim_tavern.message: Hey, this one is mine. Buy your own mead from Birgil over there.
*hic* Hey theeere kid. Will you buy an old-timer like me a new round of mead?

replies.text: Yikes, what happened to you? Get away from me.
No way, and stop blocking my way.

conversationlist_prim_tavern.message: Hey hey, thanks a lot kid! *hic*
Got a hold of poor Kirg they did.

replies.text: What do you know about Lorn's accident?

conversationlist_prim_guthbered.message: You again? Leave this place and go to your friends up in the Blackwater mountain settlement instead. We want no business with you.

replies.text: I am here to give you a message from the Blackwater mountain settlement.

conversationlist_prim_guthbered.message: What message?

replies.text: Harlenn in the Blackwater mountain settlement wants you to stop your attacks on their settlement.

conversationlist_prim_guthbered.message: That's completely insane. We!? Stop OUR attacks?! You tell him that we have nothing to do with what happens up there. They have brought their own misfortune upon themselves.
Welcome back, traveller. Did you talk to Harlenn up in the Blackwater mountain settlement?

replies.text: Can you tell me the story about the monsters again?
What was I supposed to do again?
Can you tell me the story about Prim again?
Yes, but Harlenn denies that they have anything to do with the attacks.
Actually, I am here to give you a message from the Blackwater mountain settlement.

conversationlist_prim_guthbered.message: Welcome to Prim, traveller.

replies.text: What can you tell me about Prim?
I was told to see you about helping against the monster attacks.
Actually, I am here to give you a message from the Blackwater mountain settlement.

conversationlist_prim_guthbered.message: Prim began as a simple camp for the miners that worked in the mines around here. Later it grew to a settlement, and a few years back we even got a tavern and an inn here.
This place used to be full of life when the miners worked here.
The miners also attracted a lot of traders that used to come through here.
Just until recently, we could at least get some contact with the outside villages. Nowadays, that hope is lost.
You see, the mine tunnel to the south is collapsed, and no one can get in or out of Prim.

replies.text: I know, I just came from there.

conversationlist_prim_guthbered.message: You did? Oh. Well, yes of course you must have since you are not from Prim. So there's a way through it after all huh?

replies.text: Yes, but I had to go through the old pitch-black mine.
Yes, the passage in the mine below is safe.
No, just kidding. I scaled over the mountain ridge to get here.

conversationlist_prim_guthbered.message: OK. We will have to investigate that later.
Anyway, as I was saying...
The collapsed mine tunnel makes it hard for any traders to reach Prim. Our resources are really starting to dwindle.
We are not sure. But we have our suspicions.
On top of that, there are the attacks from the monsters that we have to deal with.

replies.text: Yes, I noticed some monsters outside the village.

conversationlist_prim_guthbered.message: I am Guthbered, protector of this village.

replies.text: What can you tell me about Prim?
I was told to see you about helping against the monster attacks.

conversationlist_prim_guthbered.message: A while ago, we started seeing the first of the monsters. At first, they were no problem for us to handle. Our guards could cut them down easily.
But after a while, some of our guards got hurt, and the monsters started increasing in numbers.
Also, the monsters almost seemed like they were getting smarter. Their attacks were getting more and more coordinated.
Now, we can hardly hold them back. They mostly come at night.
According to lore, the monsters are called the 'gornauds'.

replies.text: Any ideas where they might be coming from?

conversationlist_prim_guthbered.message: Oh yes, we are almost certain.
Those evil bastards up in the Blackwater mountain settlement probably summoned them to attack us. They would rather see us perish.
Oh good. Did you talk to Tonis? Yes, I'm sure you met him on your way into town.
Good. Let me tell you the back-story about Prim first.

replies.text: I'd rather skip to the end directly.

conversationlist_prim_guthbered.message: We used to trade with them up there, but that all changed once they got greedy.

replies.text: I met a man outside the collapsed mine saying he was from the Blackwater mountain settlement.
Do you need any help in dealing with those monsters?
I would be glad to help you with the monsters.

conversationlist_prim_guthbered.message: Oh boy, do we? Yes please, you are welcome to help.

replies.text: I would be glad to help you with the monsters.

conversationlist_prim_guthbered.message: Do you really think you have what it takes to help us?

replies.text: I have left a bloody trail of monsters behind me.
If the monsters are anything like those around where I entered the mine, it will be a tough fight. But I can manage it.

conversationlist_prim_guthbered.message: Great. I think we should go straight to the source with the problem.
A man, from the Blackwater mountain settlement, you say?
Did he say anything about us here in Prim?

replies.text: No. But he insisted that I go straight east when exiting the mine, thus not reaching Prim.

conversationlist_prim_guthbered.message: That figures. They send out their spies even now.

replies.text: Do you need any help in dealing with those monsters?

conversationlist_prim_guthbered.message: As I said, we believe those bastards up at the Blackwater mountain settlement are behind the monster attacks somehow.
I want you to go up there to their settlement and ask their battle master, Harlenn, why they are doing this to us.

replies.text: OK, I will go ask Harlenn in the Blackwater mountain settlement why they are attacking your village.

conversationlist_prim_guthbered.message: Thank you friend.
What did I expect? Of course he would say that. He probably even denies it to himself. Meanwhile, we here in Prim suffer from their savage raids.
I am sure they are behind these attacks. However, I do not have sufficient evidence to back up my statements in order to do anything about it.
But I am sure they are! As false as they are, they must be. Always lying and deceiving. Causing destruction and turmoil.
Just listen to the name they have chosen for themselves: 'Blackwater'. The tone of it sounds like trouble.
Anyway. I would like to get some further evidence on what they are up to. Maybe something you can help us with.
But I need to be sure that I can trust you. If you are working for them, you had better tell me now before things get ... messy.

replies.text: Sure, you can trust me. I will help the people of Prim.
Hmm, maybe I should help the people up in Blackwater mountain instead.

conversationlist_prim_guthbered.message: Yet somehow I do not trust you.

replies.text: I was working for them, but I have decided to help you instead.
Why would I ever want to work for your filthy village? The people in the Blackwater mountain settlement deserve my help more than you.

conversationlist_prim_guthbered.message: Good. I'm glad you want to help us.
Fine. You should leave now while you still can, traitor.
I want you to go up there into their settlement and find any clues as to what they are planning.
We believe they are training their fighters to launch a larger raid on us soon.
Go look for any plans that you might find. But make sure that they do not see you while you're looking around.
You should probably start your search around where their battle master, Harlenn, stays.

replies.text: OK. I will look for clues in their settlement.

conversationlist_prim_guthbered.message: Thank you, friend. Report back to me with your findings.
Hello again. Did you find anything up in the Blackwater mountain settlement?

replies.text: What was I supposed to do again?
Yes, I found some papers with a plan to attack Prim.

conversationlist_prim_guthbered.message: Then it is as we suspected. This is terrible news indeed.
Now you know what I was talking about. They are always looking to cause trouble.
Thank you for finding this information for us.
Very well. We will have to deal with this.
I had hoped it would not come to this. But we are left with no choice. We must remove their main driving force behind the raids. We must remove their battle master, Harlenn.
This would be an excellent task for you my friend. Since you have access to their facilities, you can sneak in and kill that bastard Harlenn.
By killing him, we can be sure that their attacks will ... shall we say ... lose their teeth. He he.

replies.text: No problem, he is as good as dead.
Are you sure more violence will really solve this conflict?

conversationlist_prim_guthbered.message: Excellent. Return to me once you are done.
No, not really. But for now, it looks like the only option we have.

replies.text: I will remove him, but I will try to find a peaceful solution to this.
Very well. He is as good as dead.

conversationlist_prim_guthbered.message: My sources from inside the Blackwater mountain settlement tell me you are working for them.
It is, of course, your choice. But if you are working for them, you are not welcome here in Prim. You should leave quickly, while you still can.
Hello again my friend. Thank you for your help in dealing with the bandits up in Blackwater mountain.
I am sure everyone here in Prim will want to talk to you now.
Thank you again for your help.
The glow in your eyes frightens me.

replies.text: I am sent by the Blackwater mountain settlement to stop you.
I am sent by the Blackwater mountain settlement to stop you. However, I have decided not to kill you.

conversationlist_prim_guthbered.message: I had hoped it would not come to this. I'm afraid that you will not survive this encounter. Yet another life on my hands.

replies.text: Brave words, let's see if you can back them up with anything.
Great, I have been longing to kill you.

conversationlist_prim_guthbered.message: How interesting... Please continue.

replies.text: It's obvious that this conflict will only end in more bloodshed. That should stop here.

conversationlist_prim_guthbered.message: What are you proposing?

replies.text: My proposal is that you leave this village and find a new home somewhere else.

conversationlist_prim_guthbered.message: Now why would I want to do that?

replies.text: These two towns will always fight each other. By you leaving, they will think they have won, and stop their attacks.

conversationlist_prim_guthbered.message: Hmm, you might have a point there.
OK, you have convinced me. I will leave Prim for another town. The survival of my people here is more important than me.
Thank you friend, for talking some sense into me.
Hello again. Did you manage to remove that bastard battle master Harlenn from the Blackwater mountain settlement?

replies.text: Can you tell me again what I was supposed to do?
Not yet. I am still working on it.

conversationlist_prim_guthbered.message: While I am grateful for this news in knowing that he is dead, I am also saddened that it had to come to this.
Really? This is great news indeed.
This will hopefully mean that their attacks on our village will cease.
I do not know how to thank you enough my friend.
Here, please accept these few items as some form of compensation for your help. Also, take this piece of paper that we have acquired.
This is a permit that we have ... produced, which according to our sources, will allow you to enter their inner chamber in the Blackwater mountain settlement.
Now, the permit is not ... shall we say ... completely genuine. But we are certain that the guards won't notice any difference.
Anyway, you have my greatest thanks for the assistance that you have provided for us.

conversationlist_blackwater_signs.message:

conversationlist_blackwater_harlenn.message: Welcome, traveller.
You must be the newcomer that I heard about that traveled up the mountainside.
We need your help in dealing with some ... problems.
Oh sorry, I did not introduce myself properly. I am Harlenn, battle master of the people living in this mountain settlement.

replies.text: I was told to see you by the guide that led me up the mountain.

conversationlist_blackwater_harlenn.message: Oh yes, we are lucky he found you. You see, we seldom travel that far down the mountain.
We spend most of our time in the settlement up here on the mountain.
However, recent events have forced us to send for help. We are lucky you found us.

replies.text: What problems are you referring to?

conversationlist_blackwater_harlenn.message: I am sure you noticed just by getting here. The monsters of course!
Those damn beasts outside our very settlement. The white wyrms and the aulaeth, and their trainers are even deadlier.

replies.text: Those? They were no match for me.
I can see where this is going. You need me to deal with them for you I guess?
At least they aren't anything like those gornaud beasts at the bottom of the mountain.

conversationlist_blackwater_harlenn.message: Well, yes. But just killing them won't have any effect. We have tried that, to no avail. They just keep coming back.
You sound like my kind of type!
Gornaud? I haven't heard about those. But I'm sure they couldn't possibly be worse than these beasts up here.
Anyway, the beasts are really starting to cut down our numbers. But they are not our only concern.
On top of that, we are being attacked by raids from those bastards down in that low-life town of Prim at the base of the mountain.
Oh, those treacherous, fake bastards.

replies.text: I talked to Guthbered in Prim. They say you are the ones doing the attacks, and that you are behind the gornaud attacks on Prim.
Is there anything I can do to help?

conversationlist_blackwater_harlenn.message: They come here at night and sabotage our supplies.
We are almost certain they are the ones behind these monsters also.

replies.text: I talked to Guthbered in Prim. They say you are the ones doing the attacks, and that you are behind the gornaud attacks on Prim.
Is there anything I can do to help?

conversationlist_blackwater_harlenn.message: Why, yes. Of course. If you are up to it.
Considering you made it up here alive, I'm pretty sure you can handle yourself.
We?! Hah! It figures he would say that. They are always lying and cheating to get things their way. We have certainly not attacked them!
It is, of course, *they* who are the ones causing all the trouble.
They even captured one of our fellow scouts. Who knows what they have done to him.
I'm telling you, they are treacherous and lying!

replies.text: Sure, I believe you. What do you need from me?
What would I gain by helping you instead of them?
I'm not buying this. I think I would rather help the people of Prim than you people.

conversationlist_blackwater_harlenn.message: Gain? Our trust of course. You would always be welcome here in our camp. Our traders have some excellent equipment.

replies.text: OK, I'll help you deal with them.
I'm still not convinced, but I'll help you for now.

conversationlist_blackwater_harlenn.message: Good. We will need an able fighter to help us deal with the monsters and the Prim bandits.
Bah. Then you are useless to me. Why did you even bother to come up here and waste my time? Begone.
OK, this is the plan. I want you to go talk to Guthbered down in Prim, and give him our ultimatum:
Either they stop their attacks, or we will have to deal with them.

replies.text: Sure. I will go tell him your ultimatum.
No. In fact, I think I should help the people of Prim instead.

conversationlist_blackwater_harlenn.message: Good. Now hurry! We don't know how much time we have left before they attack again.
You again? I want no business with you. Leave me.

replies.text: Why are you people attacking the village of Prim?

conversationlist_blackwater_harlenn.message: Welcome back, traveller. What's on your mind?

replies.text: I talked to Guthbered in Prim. They say you are attacking Prim, and that you are behind the gornaud attacks on Prim.
What was that you said earlier about the monsters that are attacking your settlement?

conversationlist_blackwater_harlenn.message: Welcome back, traveller. Did you talk to that deceiving Guthbered down in Prim?

replies.text: What was I supposed to do again?
Yes, I talked to him. He denies that they are behind any of the attacks.
I talked to Guthbered in Prim. They say you are the ones doing the attacks, and that you are behind the gornaud attacks on Prim.

conversationlist_blackwater_harlenn.message: My scouts have given me a most interesting report. They say you are working for Prim.
Of course we can't have that here. We can't have a spy in our midst. You should leave our settlement while you still can, traitor.
Thank you, friend. Your help is greatly appreciated. Everyone in the Blackwater mountain settlement will want to talk to you now.
I'm sure the monster attacks will stop now when we kill the last few monsters that are outside the settlement.
He denies it?! Bah, that treacherous fool. I should have known that he wouldn't dare tell the truth.
I am still sure that they somehow are behind all these attacks on us. Who else could there be? There are no other settlements around here for quite a walk.
Besides, they have always been treacherous. No, of course they are behind the attacks.
OK, this leaves us with no choice. We will have to step this up to another level.
Are you sure you are up to it? You are not one of their spies are you? If you are working for them, then you should know that they are not to be trusted!

replies.text: I am ready for anything. I will help your settlement.
Actually, now that you mention it...
Yes, I am working for Prim also. They seem like sensible people.

conversationlist_blackwater_harlenn.message: What? Are you working for them or not?

replies.text: No, never mind. I am ready to help your settlement.
I was. But I have decided to help you instead.
Yes. I am helping them get rid of you people.

conversationlist_blackwater_harlenn.message: Good.
We believe they are planning to attack us any day now. But we lack the proof that we would need to do anything about it.
This is where I think an outsider like you might help.
I want you to go investigate Prim for any signs that you might find of them preparing an attack on us.
Good. Try not to be seen. You should go look for any clues around where that deceiving Guthbered stays.
Hello again. Did you find any clues in Prim that they are planning to attack us?

replies.text: Yes. I found plans that they are recruiting mercenaries and will attack your settlement.
What was I supposed to do again?

conversationlist_blackwater_harlenn.message: Keep looking. I am sure they are planning something wicked.
I knew it! I knew they were up to something.
Oh that lying pig Guthbered.
Anyway, thank you for your help in finding this evidence.
This calls for drastic measures. We have to act quickly before they can have time to complete their plan.
An old saying goes something like 'The only way to truly kill the Gorgon is by removing the head'. In this case, the head of those bastards down in Prim is that fellow Guthbered.
We should do something about him. You have proven your worth so far. This will be your final assignment.
I want you to go ... deal ... with him. Guthbered. Preferably in the most painful and gruesome way you can think of.

replies.text: Are you sure more violence will really solve this conflict?
He is as good as dead.

conversationlist_blackwater_harlenn.message: You saw the plans yourself. They are going to attack us if we don't do something about them. Of course we have to kill him!

replies.text: I will remove him, but I will try to find a peaceful solution to this.
Very well. He is as good as dead.

conversationlist_blackwater_harlenn.message: Excellent. Return to me once the deed is done.
Fine. Do whatever you need to remove him, but I don't want to deal with their attacks anymore.
Your expression tells me you have blood on your mind.

replies.text: I am sent by the people of Prim to stop you.
I am sent by the people of Prim to stop you. However, I have decided not to kill you.

conversationlist_blackwater_harlenn.message: Stop me?! Ha ha. Very well, let's see who is the one being stopped here.
How interesting... Please continue.

replies.text: It's obvious that this conflict will only end in more bloodshed. That should stop here.

conversationlist_blackwater_harlenn.message: What are you proposing?

replies.text: My proposal is that you leave this settlement and find a new home somewhere else.

conversationlist_blackwater_harlenn.message: Now why would I want to do that?

replies.text: These two towns will always fight each other. By you leaving, they will think they have won, and stop their attacks.

conversationlist_blackwater_harlenn.message: Hmm, you might have a point there.
OK, you have convinced me. I will leave this settlement for another to find my home. The survival of my people here is more important than me.
Thank you friend, for talking some sense into me.
Hello again. Have you gotten rid of that lying Guthbered down in Prim?

replies.text: Not yet, but I am working on it.
What was I supposed to do again?

conversationlist_blackwater_harlenn.message: Ha ha! He is finally gone! Now we can rest comfortably in our settlement.
They will no longer attack us now that their lying leader is gone!
Thank you friend. Here, have these items as a token of our appreciation for your help.

conversationlist_blackwater_upper.message: Oh, a newcomer. Great. I hope you are here to help us with our problems.
Stay out of trouble and trouble will stay away from you.
Teehee. Mazeg's potions make you feel all tingly and funny.
Get out of my kitchen! Take a seat and I will get to you in time.
The monsters, they come at night.
Regardless, I cannot help you. My services are only for residents of Blackwater mountain, and I don't trust you enough yet.
Welcome friend. What can I do for you?

replies.text: What weapons do you have for sale?

conversationlist_blackwater_upper.message: Welcome traveller. I see you are looking at my fine selection of weapons.
I have no time for you, kid. Have to practice my skills.
...but while the forces were withdrawing, the larger part of...
Oh. A young one. Hello. Please do not disturb my students while they are studying.
Sorry, I can't talk right now.

conversationlist_blackwater_lower.message: You are welcome to rest here if you want. Pick any bed you wish.
I should warn you though that the one in the corner over there has a rotten stench to it. Someone must have spilled something onto it.
Welcome traveller. These beds are only for residents of Blackwater mountain.
Welcome friend. What can I do for you?

replies.text: What items do you have for sale?

conversationlist_blackwater_lower.message: Welcome traveller. I see you are looking at my fine selection of wares.

...Kazaul, destroyer of spilled hope...
No that's not it.

Spilled ... torment?
No that's not it either.
Argh, I can't seem to remember it.
Oh, hello. Never mind. Nothing. Just trying to remember something. Don't concern yourself with that.
Halt! You should not step any further.
There is something over there. Do you see it?
A mist? A Shadow? I'm sure I saw something moving.
Screw this guard duty stuff. I am staying back here.
Good thing we blocked that entrance from that old cabin.
[The guard gives you a patronizing look, but says nothing]
Hey, I'm staying out of your fight with the boss. Don't involve me in your schemes.
Only residents of Blackwater mountain or faction members are allowed in here.

replies.text: Here, I have a written permit to enter.

conversationlist_blackwater_lower.message: I will let you through. Please go right ahead.

replies.text: Yes, get out of my way.

conversationlist_blackwater_lower.message: A permit you say? Let me see that.
Well, it has the signature and all. I guess it checks out all right.
Oh, it is you.
Hey, psst.

replies.text: If you want to say something, speak loudly.

conversationlist_blackwater_lower.message: Harlenn is a wise and strong leader, but unfortunately just as stubborn as Guthbered.
