conversationlist_guynmart_npc.message:
[Fjoerkard empties a bottle]
Oh yes, I remember it well ... It was a dark and stormy night up in the mountains.
My men and I had been on the road for hours, without a break and without the slightest sign of getting closer to our goal.
We silently trudged one by one up the tortuous path that led up the steep slope, always wary of the treacherous shadows of the bushes on either side, and always listening for signs of danger.
You don't mind if I open another bottle?

[Fjoerkard empties the bottle]
Gornauds were said to be roaming in those mountains. We had not seen any, by the shadow, but we had already crossed their traces several times.
And there were rumors about even more dangerous creatures - I will not even name them.
A lonely hut came into sight. A friendly light in the midst of the wilderness. There we would ask to camp for the night. New strength flowed through us, when suddenly all hell broke loose.
Gornauds jumped out from behind the rocks, so close that we could clearly see their facial features. For a few terrible seconds I thought that those would be our last seconds.

[Another bottle]
But then we realized that the monsters were after an easier prey. A small figure was in front of us on the path. A child? Alone up there?
Shaken, I closed my eyes, despite the great danger. I did not want to look at the slaughter. The dreadful noise lasted only a few seconds.
The ground was soaked with red blood. But - it came from the gornauds! The child just wiped the weapon clean of blood, gave us a quick glance, and disappeared up the path.

[Another bottle]
We had had enough of that cursed march. Panicked, we ran back down the path. Tired as we were, we ran without stopping even once, to the inn in the valley, from which we had departed in the morning.
Never will I forget that useless journey. Often I see it again in a nightmare and then I seek the memory of a friendly inn. Where once there was a little girl, probably the daughter of the landlord.

[Yet another bottle]
She got some wine for an old bearded guest and asked for a tale, and he began: Oh yes, I remember it well ... It was a dark and stormy night up in the mountains.
What are you - a spy? Or just another prisoner?

replies.text: I'm a prisoner too. What is your name?
I'm $playername. Lady Hannah asked me to look for someone called Lovis.

conversationlist_guynmart_npc.message: No, you must tell me your name first.

replies.text: No, first you will tell me your name.
If you are going to be so rude, I have nothing to say.
I am $playername. Lady Hannah asked me to look for someone called Lovis.

conversationlist_guynmart_npc.message: You come from Hannah? I must be sure. Prove it!

replies.text: Here, I should give you this.
Oh dear - I forgot to bring your flute!

conversationlist_guynmart_npc.message: My flute! How I have missed it! I believe you now.

replies.text: This is settled then. Let us now look for an exit.

conversationlist_guynmart_npc.message: What a dreadful place. Time seems endless here.

replies.text: Yes, but we must not give up hope.

conversationlist_guynmart_npc.message: I will play something on my flute. Maybe this will give us some hope.

replies.text: Please do. Maybe a tune you used to play for Lady Hannah?
Is that a good idea? We might disturb someone.

conversationlist_guynmart_npc.message: [Fluting]

replies.text: What a lovely tune! I almost seem to understand the meaning.
Eh, nice, thank you for trying.

conversationlist_guynmart_npc.message: [Fluting]
[Fluting]
Hush - I hear footsteps.

replies.text: Maybe some friendly soul will let us out? After all, we are completely innocent.

conversationlist_guynmart_npc.message: Oh no! Look! The torturer! I will run around him and look for Guynmart's personal guards outside in the wood. They will help us. I hope Guynmart himself is also with them.

replies.text: OK, we will see each other later.
I will try to still be alive then.

conversationlist_guynmart_npc.message: Hello $playername.
$playername - what a joy to see you again.
Welcome $playername - you helped us in our greatest needs. But let Lady Hannah speak first.
We are deeply in your debt, indeed.
We also have good news for you.
Rorthron, the ringmaker, was behaving rather strangely, and so we questioned him. It came to light that he seems to have damaged one of your rings.
He eventually admitted that he secretly exchanged your ring for a worthless ring.
He promised never to do such things again and handed the real ring over to us. We want to leave it at that.
So here, take your precious ring back.

replies.text: Oh! I can't believe it! Is it really true?

conversationlist_guynmart_npc.message: You have earned your reward. Go now into our treasury.
So you found something you like. Good.

replies.text: Oh yes - I am overwhelmed by your generosity!

conversationlist_guynmart_npc.message: We prepared a surprise for you. Go and look east of the castle near the sheep pasture. Farewell until we meet again!
At last we have to part. Farewell until we meet again! When you will find your brother, tell him that he is always welcome.
Regrettably, we still have to sort out an unpleasant thing. Let our shepherd speak.
Grumble ... grumble...
It seems sheep were killed by your hand. Our sheep, to be precise.
You will be fined 100 gold for each sheep you killed. Do you accept this judgment?

replies.text: Yes, what I did was stupid.
I can explain - it was an accident...

conversationlist_guynmart_npc.message: As you wish. I already regret that we prepared a surprise for you next to the sheep pastures. I am very disappointed in you. Go now.

replies.text: No, sorry, I didn't mean it.

conversationlist_guynmart_npc.message: As you wish. I am very disappointed with you - go now.

replies.text: No, sorry, I didn't mean it.

conversationlist_guynmart_npc.message: 100 gold for the killed sheep.
200 gold for 2 killed sheep.
300 gold for 3 killed sheep.
400 gold for 4 killed sheep.
500 gold for 5 killed sheep.
600 gold for 6 killed sheep.
700 gold for 7 killed sheep.
800 gold for 8 killed sheep.
900 gold for 9 killed sheep.
{1000} gold for 10 or perhaps even more killed sheep.
{1500} gold for 15 or perhaps even more killed sheep.
{2000} gold for 20 or perhaps even more killed sheep.
{2500} gold for 25 or perhaps even more killed sheep.
You will find a way to get the missing gold. Then come back and pay the rest.

[Gold taken]
All the sheep you killed are paid for, so now we will forget the whole thing.
We have good news for you.
Rorthron, the ringmaker, was behaving rather strangely, and so we questioned him. It came to light that he seems to have damaged one of your rings.
He eventually admitted that he secretly exchanged your ring for a worthless ring.
He promised never to do such things again and handed the real ring over to us. We want to leave it at that.
So here, take your precious ring back.

replies.text: Oh! I can't believe it! Is it really true?

conversationlist_guynmart_npc.message: The ring. This human wears the ring of bone. Let him pass.

replies.text: A bit scary - but really useful, this ring.
You are in my way. Attack!

conversationlist_guynmart_npc.message: Who is there?
Good. At last. Go and bring Norgothla here.

replies.text: Norgothla is out in the woods and awaits you there with his men. Unkorh persuaded him that you commanded that.

conversationlist_guynmart_npc.message: Unkorh! I curse the day when I made him my steward.

replies.text: How can I help you now? Shall I search for the keys to your cell?

conversationlist_guynmart_npc.message: No time for that. I am too weak to be of much help. We need Norgothla now.

replies.text: Lovis is on his way to him. He can probably persuade Norgothla to come to the castle.

conversationlist_guynmart_npc.message: Good. Norgothla knows and trusts him. Tell me - is the main gate shut?

replies.text: Yes. I came through the garden door.

conversationlist_guynmart_npc.message:
Then you must open the gate! Go to the gatehouse and open it, so that my men can get in. Be quick.
After that go to the farm south of here. I expect a ferocious battle.
YOU AGAIN!
[Groaning] ...open the gate...
...then go ... to Rhodita...
[Groaning]

replies.text: You don't talk too much, do you?

conversationlist_guynmart_npc.message: $playername enters!
Who may I please announce?
[Whispering] You should talk to Lovis again.
[Whispering] You should talk again to Unkorh.
No entry!
Come in, and take your time! You may choose one of three things.
You made a good choice.
On the table there are {5000} shining gold coins.
You feel the pleasant weight of the gold in your bag.
On the table you see a scroll with the texts of wise men.
You feel an immediate benefit from the experience of others.
On the table lies a beautifully crafted shield.
This shield does feel good in your hands.
Hello $playername - great to meet you again!

replies.text: Norgothla! So you made it here.

conversationlist_guynmart_npc.message: Yes. Unkorh is still on the run, but my men are close behind him, thanks to you.

replies.text: It was you who did all the hard work, I just helped a bit.
I really would like to hunt him down.

conversationlist_guynmart2.message:
The road is closed.
Signed: Unkorh, Steward of Guynmart Castle
This raft does not look very trustworthy.

replies.text: I can't swim. It is better if I do not try this old raft.

conversationlist_guynmart2.message: Oh no, the raft has drifted off!
I could tie this rope to the tree and climb down.
Hello $playername. Do you wish to climb up to me?

replies.text: Yes. Could you drop the rope down?

conversationlist_guynmart2.message:
* Dedicated to $playername * 
 Our help in times of great need

* D A N G E R *
Do not enter the fog!

conversationlist_guynmart2_npc.message: I am the new Feygard bridge guard. Har har. We do not let beggars through. Understand? Come back, but only if you have more gold with you.
I am the new Feygard bridge guard. Har har. Give me your gold.

replies.text: OK. Here, you can have 50 pieces of gold. Let me pass now.
Come and try to get it.
Hmm, I will think about your offer.

conversationlist_guynmart2_npc.message:
[Gold taken]
Very good. But I need more.

replies.text: Of course. Here, you can have another 50 pieces of gold.
Hmm, I will think about your offer.

conversationlist_guynmart2_npc.message: Sorry, the road to Feygard is closed until further notice.

replies.text: Oh? Is it the fog that is the problem?

conversationlist_guynmart2_npc.message: Yes. Several men already got lost and never reappeared. There is no way through.
Welcome! Nice to see you again.
Good morning! Did you hear the music last night? I think it came from the castle.
What is a kid like you doing all alone on the road?

replies.text: I am looking for my brother Andor. Have you seen him by any chance?
I am tired and hungry. Do you have a place to rest, please?

conversationlist_guynmart2_npc.message: No, sorry. We seldom see strangers in the area. But you could ask at Guynmart Castle. Just follow the road to the north, you can't miss it.

replies.text: Guynmart Castle? I have never heard of it. Please tell me more.

conversationlist_guynmart2_npc.message: Our land belongs to Guynmart Castle, but old Guynmart is a friendly and righteous man. He never takes too much from us.
Young Lady Hannah of Guynmart Castle often comes to visit us. A lovely girl she is. But she has not been here for a week now. I wonder if everything is all right.
I have too much work to do now. But maybe you could check if everything is OK with her?

replies.text: Yes, of course. I will come back and tell you what I find out.
No, sorry. I have to press on again. Bye.
I will go tomorrow. But now I am tired and hungry. Do you have a place to rest, please?

conversationlist_guynmart2_npc.message: Yes of course. Go inside, there is some food left, and some cushions in the corner behind the oven. I will join you later.
Hi! Any news from Guynmart castle?

replies.text: Oh yes, it is a long story. Maybe I could stay overnight and tell you all about it in detail?
Yes, but I want to learn more about what is going on before I am willing to discuss it.

conversationlist_guynmart2_npc.message: With pleasure. Just go inside and make yourself comfortable on the cushions in the corner behind the oven. We will talk when my work is done.
Grrrrrr
Hello stranger. Who are you and where are you going?

replies.text: I am $playername, and come from the castle.

conversationlist_guynmart2_npc.message: From the castle? You did not come here the usual way.

replies.text: You are right. I had a misunderstanding with Unkorh the steward and he threw me off the north wall. Now I am looking for a way back.

conversationlist_guynmart2_npc.message: You were kicked out? And still want to go back? You must explain that.

replies.text: I spoke to Lady Hannah there. She bade me to find her betrothed, who has been missing for a week now.

conversationlist_guynmart2_npc.message:
Lovis is missing? That is bad news.
But where are my manners? I am questioning you and haven't even introduced myself. I am Norgothla, head of Guynmart's personal guard, and these are my men.
You say Lovis is missing? I would like to look around the castle, but we are ordered to stay here.
I take orders only from Lord Guynmart himself. He told me and my men to go to this clearing and wait for him.

replies.text: That is strange. I heard at the castle that Lord Guynmart was uproad for a week now.

conversationlist_guynmart2_npc.message: Yes, Lord Guynmart was already on the way. Unkorh forwarded his order to me.

replies.text: I also heard other things that I dare not tell.

conversationlist_guynmart2_npc.message: You must tell me all that you know or think you know. I promise that you have nothing to fear.

replies.text: I heard Unkorh saying that Guynmart is imprisoned in the dungeons. And Unkorh also wants to marry Lady Hannah.

conversationlist_guynmart2_npc.message: Indeed? These are serious accusations. I hope you can prove them.

replies.text: How can I? You may go to the castle and check for yourself.

conversationlist_guynmart2_npc.message:
Now I am really curious what is going on in the castle. But unfortunately Guynmart's order was very clear. Myself and all my men should wait for him in this clearing.
I can't leave just based on the words of a kid.

replies.text: And let Unkorh's dark plans be fulfilled? Leave Guynmart to probably die?
Maybe I could go back and bring some evidence?

conversationlist_guynmart2_npc.message: Maybe you could go back to the castle and bring some evidence?

replies.text: With pleasure, if this means you will believe me.

conversationlist_guynmart2_npc.message: By doing this, you take a great burden from my heart. I get to know what is happening at the castle, but don't have to disobey my lords order. Please hurry, the path is not difficult to find.

replies.text: OK, I will be as quick as I can.

conversationlist_guynmart2_npc.message: Halt! Talk to Norgothla before you walk around here!
Go away, kid.
Go away, kid. I am depressed.
They have all gone, and forgotten me here. *Sigh*
Hey! You are the first one that has found the way to my clearing!
I like this place very much. Each time I return here, I get a surprise.
Cool place here, isn't it?
I like the clearing best this way.
A little too hot for my taste.
I don't even know what this is supposed to be!
This is strange!
Back to normal.
Hello $playername. Do you wish to climb up to me?

replies.text: Yes. Could you drop the rope down?

conversationlist_guynmart2_npc.message: Of course. There. But I am in a hurry and must leave now.
Grumble ... grumble...

replies.text: He seems to speak mostly to his dogs.

conversationlist_guynmart2_npc.message: Grrumble ... grrrrumble...

replies.text: Maybe he does not like his sheep being killed?

conversationlist_guynmart2_npc.message: GRRRUMMBLE!!!

replies.text: Obviously he does not like his sheep being killed.

conversationlist_guynmart2_npc.message: Baah!
Neigh.
The left beetle will win.
No, the right beetle will win.
Nonsense, the left beetle will win.
The right beetle will win.
Hey, come and join our beetle battle.
*Sob*

replies.text: Don't cry, little one. What's your name?

conversationlist_guynmart2_npc.message: *Sob* ... Stuephant ... *sob*

replies.text: There there now. What's the matter?

conversationlist_guynmart2_npc.message: I have lost my five best marbles!

replies.text: Oh dear, That is all? I will find them for you.
Look, here I have a nice teddy bear for you.
The quicker I leave, the sooner I have silence and peace again.

conversationlist_guynmart2_npc.message: Great - thank you!

replies.text: Much better. Now tell me about your marbles.

conversationlist_guynmart2_npc.message: I have lost them here in the yard or in the field over there.
Five beautiful marbles. Maybe you should look more than once in each place. They are so small you could easily miss them.

replies.text: Don't be so sad, I will find them soon.

conversationlist_guynmart2_npc.message: *Sob* ... so you didn't find my marbles ... *sob*

replies.text: I haven't given up yet. Please be patient.

conversationlist_guynmart2_npc.message: Thank you again for finding my marbles.

My lost marbles! All five! Great, thank you!
[Stuephant takes the marbles]
I found a green marble!
I found a red marble!
I found a pink marble!
Wow - a golden marble!
I found a pearl white marble!
That was the last one. I have found them all. Stuephant will be happy.

replies.text: I will go back to him now.

conversationlist_guynmart2_npc.message: Oh, a visitor. Come closer. Do not be afraid of me.

replies.text: I am not afraid. What happened to you?

conversationlist_guynmart2_npc.message: Oh, it is you again. I am delighted!

replies.text: De-lighted indeed. Might you need anything?

conversationlist_guynmart2_npc.message: It happened in the mines of Mount Galmore. Don't ask any more, I do not wish to recall the memories. It was horrible.
When I returned here at last, people started to avoid me, whispering behind my back. I got very lonely.
Eventually I had enough of all the anxious, disturbed looks, so I came up here on this lonely hill.
From time to time a friendly soul brings me some food, but no one stays for long. I have noticed that their pace uphill is usually much slower than back downhill.
Do you bring bread and wine, together with my favorite cheddar?

replies.text: Yes, finally I got it. I hope the cheddar is still fresh after the long journey.

conversationlist_guynmart2_npc.message: Do you bring bread, cheese and wine?

replies.text: Yes, here you are. Enjoy it!

conversationlist_guynmart2_npc.message: No, thank you.
Just recently my supply of bread has run low again. And I haven't seen eggs for such a long time...

replies.text: I can help with that. I can spare 2 loaves of bread.
I could spare bread, some cheese and a bottle of red wine.
Unfortunately I have nothing I could give you.
Sad for you. I have to go now. Bye.

conversationlist_guynmart2_npc.message: Thank you! Thank you very much!
Would it be really outrageous if I asked you to fulfill my heart's desire?

replies.text: Sorry, I really must go now.
Just say what you would like. What can I do for you?

conversationlist_guynmart2_npc.message: I long for a meal with bread and cheese and a good bottle of wine. Oh, what would I give for that?

replies.text: Here I have bread, some cheese and a bottle of red wine.
Really? That is all? I will come back soon.
Be content with what you got, you greedy old man.

conversationlist_guynmart2_npc.message: Oh yes - you get the best cheese in Charwood, if you don't mind!

replies.text: Charwood? That's not exactly next door...
I have heard of Charwood, but I don't know where it is.
I have heard of Charwood, but I don't know where it is.
Charwood? I have never heard of it.

conversationlist_guynmart2_npc.message: What a feast! I have no words to thank you!
So take this ring as a token of my gratitude. Certain beings in the cellars of Guynmart Castle will not harm you if they see my ring on your finger.

replies.text: The ring looks interesting. Thank you.

conversationlist_guynmart2_npc.message: Eh...
now...

replies.text: Oh dear! Just say what is on your mind. What's up?

conversationlist_guynmart2_npc.message: The cheese that you brought - It was OK. But it is not the best cheese, you know? The best cheese is from Charwood.
Their Cheddar is a dream! But they sell it only when you explicitly ask for it.

replies.text: No problem. I will go and get some.
I am not going to go all the way to Charwood for some cheddar.

conversationlist_guynmart2_npc.message: Great! I will wait for your return.
Cheddar! I can't believe it!
[Eating]
It was nice to talk to you. Come again, as often as you like!
$playername monument - not bad.
Ah - I can see it before my eyes: a loaf of bread with a piece of delicious cheese! No, better two loaves of bread.
Along with a bottle of good red wine!
The bread maybe still warm ...
Sigh.
Two loaves of bread! Hmmmm.
And cheese - how I missed it!
A bottle of red wine with it, of course. Ooooh!

replies.text: I'm beginning to find your requests outrageous. I have to leave now.

conversationlist_guynmart2_npc.message: Noo! Please, don't go! I didn't mean it.

replies.text: OK. Bread, cheese and vine - that's it?

conversationlist_guynmart2_npc.message: Great! It's settled then, I'll wait for you here.

replies.text: I'll hurry now. See you soon.

conversationlist_guynmart2_npc.message: Ah - bread ...
And cheese ...
Vine ...

replies.text: How do I get to Remgard?
What can you tell me about Remgard?
Do you have anything to trade?
I'm looking for my brother, Andor. He looks a bit like me.

conversationlist_trader_teksin.message: Hello. My name is Teksin. I'm a trader. Who are you?

replies.text: I am $playername. I am looking for my brother, Andor. He looks a bit like me.

conversationlist_trader_teksin.message: Sorry. I haven't seen anyone that looks like you.
I have been out in the wild for a while, and have seen nobody since I left the main road weeks ago.
I decided that I should find a better route to Remgard. The road through the mountains to the east is plagued by terrible monsters. My quest for a better route was a mistake though.

This is as close as I can get coming this way. I am an experienced traveler, and I know that Remgard is close. It's north across this lake, but there is no way to cross, or to go further east around the lake.

replies.text: It sounds like you are not quite the experienced traveler you claim to be.
I guess it was worth a try. What can you tell me about Remgard?
How do I get to Remgard?
Do you have anything to trade?

conversationlist_trader_teksin.message: Remgard is a town that is well protected by the lake that we are next to. It is peaceful, and far from any enemies, which makes it somewhat surprising that they make excellent armor there. The high quality of the goods available in Remgard is the reason it is on my trading route, even though it is so hard to get to.

replies.text: How do I get to Remgard?
Thanks for the information, but I have to leave now.

conversationlist_trader_teksin.message: You have to go back down to the river, then south until you find some caves. Go through the caves, up through the mountains, and then around the lake we are now standing next to. It's a long way, and as I said, there are some very bad monsters. A kid like you should probably not attempt it.

replies.text: I can handle it. I'm on my way.
It sounds dangerous. I think I'll go somewhere else.
Thanks for the information. Do you have anything to trade?

conversationlist_trader_teksin.message:
Yes. I think you will see that I sell quality items from many places.
Under the circumstances I can only sell you limited provisions though.

I do also have one special item. It is a potion that increases your attack speed.
It is very rare, and therefore expensive, but I am willing to part with it if the price is right.

replies.text: No thanks. Show me what else you have.
OK. Show me what you have.

conversationlist_trader_teksin.message: For you, I will offer the special price of {4999} gold.

replies.text: I don't have that much gold. Please show me what else you have.
That's too expensive. Please show me what else you have.
I think I'll just be on my way.

conversationlist_trader_teksin.message:
Use it wisely. Such a potion is very hard to obtain. 
It is unlikely I will have any more to sell in the future.

replies.text: Thanks for the advice. Please show me what else you have to trade.
Thanks for the advice. I need to go now.

conversationlist_stoutford_combined.message: Hello there. Please do not bother me, I have a lot of work to do.
Hello. Could you please move out of the way? I am trying to work here.
Welcome to our wonderful Inn. How can we help you?
My name is Cadoren. I'm the best cook in town.
Unlike most, lesser, cooks in local towns, I'm a specialist.

replies.text: Enough of the bragging. Show me what you have to trade.

conversationlist_stoutford_combined.message: Food that lasts a long time. *cough*. Or in some cases food that has already lasted a long time.

replies.text: That sounds interesting. Show me what you have.
Why do you need food that lasts a long time?

conversationlist_stoutford_combined.message: The path to Blackwater mountain has been cut off. There are also increasing attacks by monsters. These things have driven down trade, making supplies hard to get.

replies.text: So all the food you sell is old?
Thanks for the information. I have to leave now.

conversationlist_stoutford_combined.message: Hello, welcome to my shop.

replies.text: Please show me what you have to trade.
What can you tell me about the town and local area?
I'm looking for my brother, Andor. He looks a bit like me.

conversationlist_stoutford_combined.message: Stoutford is not a big town, but it used to be important.
Sorry, I don't recall seeing anyone like that recently. Most visitors go to the inn though, so you might have more luck asking there.
Oh. No one asked before you. I didn't even think about it.
Are you willing to hear my story?

replies.text: Oh no. Not a long story.
If it can be of any comfort ... go ahead.

conversationlist_stoutford_combined.message:
Thank you. My name is Aryfora.
I met my husband here in Stoutford, during the fair.
He offered me a beautiful flower, one that I had never seen before.

He was smart and handsome and we quickly fell in love.
He was from a town called Remgard.
His name was Noraed.
He told me that it is very far from here, to the northeast, beyond the river and the mountains.
I've never been there, as he always said how dangerous that road was, but every year, for our anniversary, he went back to bring me a damerilia, the same flower he offered me on the day we met.

During one of the recent attacks on Stoutford, my husband sacrificed his life to save mine.
Now, I can't do anything but mourn next to his grave.

replies.text: He must have loved you very much.

conversationlist_stoutford_combined.message: I'd really love to place damerilias on his grave, as a symbol of our love.

replies.text: Uh oh, I suspect I am going to be asked for something...

conversationlist_stoutford_combined.message: But it would be reckless of me to ask such a young kid as you to go so far to the northeast.

replies.text: Don't worry about me. I can handle myself.
I'm an adventurer. I'm afraid of nothing.

conversationlist_stoutford_combined.message: Really? If you manage to do it, I'll make sure to reward you with something only I can do, and that I haven't done in a long time.

conversationlist_stoutford_combined.message: Dead? No - what a pity! I am really sorry. What a loss.

replies.text: I would like to take some damerilias for his grave.

conversationlist_stoutford_combined.message: Forget it. Especially because you know those people who built that terrible statue near the entrance.

replies.text: No. That statue is a blessing for the people here. Even if I could, I would not tear it down.

conversationlist_stoutford_combined.message: You lie. You think I am just a stupid troll.

replies.text: A troll had taken the key, but he won't need it any more.

conversationlist_stoutford_combined.message: Oh, it is you again. Thank you again for bringing back my key.

replies.text: No, not yet. I guess there are at least 30 trolls to kill. I will go after them again.

conversationlist_stoutford_combined.message: Please do, and come to me when you are done with them.

replies.text: Yes, I have dealt with most of the trolls. They won't dare to bother you for a long time.

conversationlist_stoutford_combined.message: Thank you so much! I wish you safe travels back to Stoutford. If you want to go to the glade next time you are in Remgard, just ask me for the key.

replies.text: Thank you. I will leave now.

conversationlist_stoutford_combined.message: Oh, it is you again. Thank you for all you have done.

replies.text: Could you give me the key for the glade again?

replies.text: So I will meet you there. Bye.

conversationlist_stoutford_combined.message: Damerilias. I haven't seen one in a long time. Try with Caeda, she used to give us a damerilia sometimes.

conversationlist_stoutford_combined.message:

replies.text: Beautiful, but deadly to get there!

conversationlist_stoutford_combined.message: My father was the alchemist of this town. He was very talented, and inspired. He experimented with all sorts of ingredients from all over Dhayavar. Whatever he could get from the travellers stopping at Stoutford.
He created unique potions, and no other alchemist that I have heard of managed to reproduce his recipes.
When he deemed me old and responsible enough, he started teaching me his art.
He passed away a few years later. They said he poisoned himself during a new experiment, but I never believed it.

replies.text: Sorry, I have to go now.

conversationlist_stoutford_combined.message: Our priest, Tahalendor, was convinced by my uncle, Blornvale, my father's own brother.
My uncle also convinced the whole village that I was too young to be their alchemist, and that they needed him to take over the shop.

They all agreed, even though my uncle is a lousy alchemist.
I was sent to work on a farm, while my uncle took my father's house and opened the shop again.
Everyone suffered from the nasty side effects of my uncle's ... I can't say potions ... poisonous imitations of my father's recipes.
People complained at first, but nobody ever looked for a real solution.
Seeing how things turned out, I came to suspect that my uncle is responsible for my father's death.

replies.text: And would you brew more potions if you had your father's shop back?

conversationlist_stoutford_combined.message: No. Every time I talk to him, he denies everything, and calls me crazy. I can tell he's lying though.

replies.text: And would you brew more potions if you had your father's shop back?

replies.text: Can I help you with this?

replies.text: Eh, I'd better leave now. It's none of my business.

replies.text: What will you do with them?

replies.text: By chance, I have three potions of the brave with me. Here, take them.

replies.text: Yes, I have them. But I won't give them to you.

conversationlist_stoutford_combined.message: I would not have expected that from you!

replies.text: But who would believe me, a stranger?

conversationlist_stoutford_combined.message: I have full confidence in you. You will come up with something.

Did Blornvale drink the potion of truth?

replies.text: Yes. I just have to make him confess to the murder.

conversationlist_stoutford_combined.message: Any news about the murderer?

replies.text: Yes, he confessed to poisoning your father.

conversationlist_stoutford_combined.message: Any news about the murderer?

replies.text: Yes, but it's not good news. He guessed that I tried to entrap him, and is cautious now.

replies.text: How do I get to Blackwater mountain?

conversationlist_stoutford_combined.message: Just follow the path west, but you will have to find a way past the rockfall.

replies.text: Thanks for the directions. I'm headed there right now.

conversationlist_stoutford_combined.message: They started attacking the town recently. Nobody is sure why. Their attacks have been unsuccessful, so we are all hoping that they will give up soon and go back to wherever they came from.

replies.text: And you have no idea where she might be?

Oh, that is a long story my friend. This town has existed for ages and it used to be a prosperous and well visited outpost on the border of the Aewhata Kingdom. We used to trade with Fallhaven and Prim.
Stoutford used to be the seat of Lord Erwyn of house Gorland. But during the Noble Wars 17 years ago, everything changed.
Well, the Noble Wars were one of the darkest periods of our history. They lasted only 3 years but brought great misery to most of the area.

When our great King Luthor died and left the throne with no heir the three mighty lords of the land soon enough began fighting over the title as successor. They were Lord Erwyn of Stoutford, Lord Geomyr of Feygard, who used to be the advisor to King Luthor, and Lord Emeric of Nor City. The former capital of Fallhaven at first remained neutral.
While Erwyn and Emeric fought to capture the central area, Lord Geomyr waited for the right moment and crushed his enemies with his great army. He has ruled the Kingdom ever since with an iron hand.

replies.text: I will clear the castle of undead for you.

replies.text: I will clear the castle of undead for you.

However, recently more and more of the most foul monsters are coming from the mountain and we have to fend them off. There are rumors that the mines are once gain being worked.
