You see two women that appear to be arguing.
The two women eventually separate and walk away from each other. You wonder what the argument was about.
The two women eventually separate and walk away from each other. You can't make out their faces from here, but you know who they probably are.
You see the mountain top you are standing on.
You see something glinting by your feet.
You have found a gem!
There is nothing more to be found here.
You look to the north.
You look to the northeast.
You look to the east.
You look to the southeast.
Suddenly, something in the sky catches your eye.
You look to the south.
You look to the southwest.
You look to the west.
You look to the northwest.
The sign is old and worn, but you can make out the words "Lake Laeroth watchtower".
You toss and turn, but sleep won't come.
Now you have got a headache. You really should give up trying to sleep.
You decide to write about this wondrous sight in your father's book of achievements.

conversationlist_omicronrg9.message: I see .... So you want to get involved in our Guild?

replies.text: Yes, you seem like reasonable people.
No, not really. I'm not interested in being a smug thief.

conversationlist_omicronrg9.message: Well, you've shown us you are trustworthy by bringing that key. However, doing just one task does not prove to us that you are eligible to be a member of our guild.

replies.text: But I really want to join your guild!
Really? I didn't see any of your members bringing you "that" key.

conversationlist_omicronrg9.message: I'm sorry to hear that. Good luck.
OK, OK. You will get a chance. But I warn you that from now on, you cannot go back on your choice.
So what is your decision?

replies.text: Haven't you understood? Just tell me what I have to do.
I need some time to think about it.

conversationlist_omicronrg9.message: Very well. Let's see if you're good enough to join our guild. Talk with Troublemaker. He will tell you what you have to do.

replies.text: All right! I'll go see him.

conversationlist_omicronrg9.message: Fine. I will keep an eye on you.
Not for now. Make sure nobody sees you doing suspicious things. Good luck.
I understand your doubts. Come back when you're prepared.
Argh, another annoying apprentice ... I mean, sorry. I know you were the one who brought us the key.
OK, now listen up!
As I expect you are aware, we're not welcome in many places. In fact, we're being pursued by Fallhaven patrols. That's why we are here. This place is safe.
But we need supplies to survive, and also to maintain the Guild's influence. We are not just common robbers.

We don't just steal gold or goods. We steal information. Secrets, shipment reports, strategic locations.
Do you know what I mean?
We have spies and scouts in certain key locations, gathering information. These locations are places frequented by people from Feygard and also from Nor City.
So you will be the intermediary this time, collecting our spies' journals and bringing them to me.

replies.text: That's not my favorite kind of job, but I will bring them.
No, I'm too strong to be just a mere broker.

conversationlist_omicronrg9.message:
Good. We have three people on the job.
The first one is a spy in Crossglen, Leta. I believe you know her.
One of our veteran spies, Dunla, is disguised as a vendor in Vilegard Tavern.
And finally we have Fanamor, watching what is happening around Crossroads Guardhouse. Search for them in this order.
Hmpf. Go kill some beetles with your strength!

Ah! I almost forgot. You have to say the password if you want them to give you the journal.
The password is "You are no one. No one knows you. No one has seen you." Good luck.

replies.text: I will keep that in mind. Bye.

conversationlist_omicronrg9.message: What? I don't know what you are talking about.

replies.text: You are no one. No one knows you. No one has seen you.
You are no one. No one knows you. No one has seen you.

conversationlist_omicronrg9.message: So, you are one of us. Here, take my journal.

replies.text: Do you have anything to trade?

conversationlist_omicronrg9.message: Sorry, I don't have any more information for you.

replies.text: Do you have anything to trade?

conversationlist_omicronrg9.message: Finally! I was getting tired of waiting here killing these beasts ...
Take this. All I've seen is written here ...
Halt! You have been caught!
In the blink of an eye, Fanamor starts attacking the scout.

Argh ... damned trash, take this! 
(His sword swings quickly, and severely wounds Fanamor)

(Grabs the book)
What have we here? A lost kid trying to do business with this scum, hah? 
You are under arrest!

replies.text: How dare you! Prepare to die, useless soldier!

conversationlist_omicronrg9.message:
Tsch ... I ... cannot ...
You kid, protect the book!
Umar you say? I don't know any Umar!

replies.text: [Whispering] You are no one. No one knows you. No one has seen you.

conversationlist_omicronrg9.message: How do you ...? Whatever, you are one of us.

replies.text: Umar sent me to get your journal.

conversationlist_omicronrg9.message: Here. Make sure you don't raise any suspicion on your future jobs. Bye kid.
I gave you all the information I have gathered. Now leave me alone.
Wow, you ... you really got rid of him ....

replies.text: Yes, even though he was strong, as we can expect of Feygard soldiers ...

conversationlist_omicronrg9.message: Watch out! Behind you!
Argh ... The Feygard Scout hit me badly. I have not much time ... I am bleeding very heavily.
Yes, I am. I have no time for jokes!
I need a bandage quickly, or I will never return to the guild house. A priest might help ...

replies.text: I will find a bandage for you, don't worry.

conversationlist_omicronrg9.message: Have you brought me that bandage?
Hurry up! I do not have much time ...
(You look away when you see the corpse of Fanamor. Anklebiters probably had something to do with this horrible event.)
What's the matter, my child?

replies.text: Ehm ... My father has cut himself with an axe, and we don't have any bandages!
Fanamor, a member of Thieves' Guild, is severely wounded. Please give me a bandage for her!

conversationlist_omicronrg9.message: Let me see ...
This is what I have, take it. I expect this will be useful.

replies.text: May the Shadow walk with you, my friend.
Thank you, I won't forget this!

conversationlist_omicronrg9.message:
(You help Fanamor put the bandage on the wound)

... I think I will be able ... to move in a few minutes. See you at the Guild. Thank you kid.

replies.text: I'm glad to hear that. Bye.

conversationlist_omicronrg9.message: How is the mission going?

replies.text: I have the journals, but one of your spies, Fanamor, was killed by a Feygard scout.
I gave you the journals, so where's my reward?
Well, but can I take a look at your supplies again?

conversationlist_omicronrg9.message: Well done kid! You can now consider yourself skilled enough to be a part of this guild.

replies.text: Yes .... So where is my reward?

conversationlist_omicronrg9.message: Well, that is the price of being one of us. There's always risk.
Return to me when you are done.

replies.text: Can you tell me again what I'm supposed to do?

conversationlist_omicronrg9.message:
You have to retrieve information from our spies.
The first one is a spy in Crossglen, Leta. I believe you know her.
One of our veteran spies, Dunla, is disguised as a vendor in Vilegard Tavern.
And finally we have Fanamor, watching what is happening around Crossroads Guardhouse. Search for them in this order.
And don't forget the password: You are no one. No one knows you. No one has seen you.
You should talk with Umar. Maybe he has another task ... one that's more in your line of work, you know.

replies.text: Sure, I will talk to him.
At least I got some gold. Bye!

conversationlist_omicronrg9.message: Hi again, kid. What do you want?

replies.text: OK ... It's done. She's alright, and probably eating some bread now.
I still have to take our guest to her quarters.
I have to ...(you look at Ambelie) find a better place for her.
[Lie] I just recovered {10000} gold from my latest mission and was told to give it to The Guild.
I have found Defy and his men.
I'm confused. I gave Defy the fake key that you gave me, but what am I supposed to do now?
I have found Defy and his men.
[Lie] I have deposited the {10000} gold. Here is your key back, as promised.
I encountered Defy and his men and was forced to kill them!
[Lie] I have deposited the {10000} gold. Here is your key back, as promised.
Can I take a look at the Guild's current supplies?
[Lie] I have deposited the {10000} gold. Here is your key back, as promised.

conversationlist_omicronrg9.message: Hello, friend! Thank you for all you've done for me.

replies.text: It's my job. Nice to see you survived those anklebiters ...
Hmm, maybe you can help me?

conversationlist_omicronrg9.message: What have you decided?
Excellent, young friend. Consider yourself a member of our Guild.

replies.text: Meh, that was nothing special. Bye.
OK, nice to see you again.
Hah, what an honor! It has been so, so difficult ....

conversationlist_omicronrg9.message: I detect a certain sarcasm in your words.

replies.text: No, no .... Never mind, see you later.
That's maybe because I am trying to be sarcastic ...

conversationlist_omicronrg9.message: What do you mean?

replies.text: Just give me a high-risk job, please.
I mean my last job was a piece of cake. I need something more exciting!

conversationlist_omicronrg9.message: If you want me to give you a more difficult task, then I am happy to do so.

replies.text: OK, in that case tell me what it is.

conversationlist_omicronrg9.message: But first I have to clarify something. You need to be more careful not to give information to outsiders about the Thieves' Guild.

replies.text: You're right. It will not happen again.

conversationlist_omicronrg9.message: Yes, you mentioned Fanamor's membership to Thoronir.
Fortunately, Thoronir will keep quiet, as he certainly does not want to give up our donations.

replies.text: You're right. It will not happen again.

conversationlist_omicronrg9.message: You still have many things to learn, young apprentice.
Well, before I can give you a very demanding job, I need you to do another ... retrieval task.

replies.text: Anything for the glory o... Oops, I mean OK

conversationlist_omicronrg9.message: Excellent. I warn you that this is not an ordinary retrieval. It's more like a ... kidnapping.

replies.text: Can you get to the point please?
Sounds too shady for me. I think I prefer to not do that task for now.

conversationlist_omicronrg9.message: Just tell me when you want to do the job. Bye

OK, listen carefully.
We have heard a noble woman has decided to travel outside Feygard.

Nothing unusual about that. But in this case we've discovered that the woman is the daughter of Hertzsen Laumwill, patriarch of the Laumwill family.

(You look around, trying to remember someone, but nothing comes to you)
To help you understand, they are one of the richest Feygard families, very close to Lord Geomyr.

replies.text: OK, so what I have to do?
I ... understand. So what's my task?

conversationlist_omicronrg9.message: I want you to bring the noble woman here, so that we can ask for a substantial ransom from her generous father.

replies.text: Where can I find this woman?

conversationlist_omicronrg9.message: Great ... Before you go, I should tell you where she is.
Scouts have seen the lady in the Foaming flask tavern. We do not want to be discovered, so act quietly. Guards are a problem though. It's up to you how you choose to solve the guards problem.

replies.text: Seems difficult, but whatever. I'll do it.

conversationlist_omicronrg9.message: Good luck. Return to me when you're done.

replies.text: Wait, wait! How am I supposed to ...
I will bring her, even if I have to eliminate Feygard's entire army!

conversationlist_omicronrg9.message: Use your tongue, young man. Sometimes it is more important than your sword skills.

replies.text: Hah! I don't think so. But anyway, thank you for the advice.
I'll do that, thanks for the advice.

conversationlist_omicronrg9.message: Remember that if you are discovered, you are no one. No one knows you. And of course, no one has seen you. You are now a member of the guild, so don't fail.

replies.text: You still think I'm a novice, right? You're going to see that you're wrong!

conversationlist_omicronrg9.message: No, I've told you all you need to know. Now leave me please, I've work to do.
Why? I don't know you, commoner. Why would I be willing to trust a savage looking kid?

replies.text: But I'm not a commoner! I'm a ... Feygard spy. These clothes are my disguise!
I'm stronger than those smug guards.

conversationlist_omicronrg9.message: Anyway, I prefer to stay in this place for now. Get away from me!
What? I haven't been informed of that. Since you seem like an inexperienced kid, I don't believe you.

replies.text: Ergh ... Mr Laumwill is grateful for your protection. However ... Ah! He has given this reward of {1000} gold for your efforts.
Trust me, I'm the one that delivered those swords from Gandoren to you!
(I would like to bribe the captain, but I need at least {1000} Gold) I will come back later.

conversationlist_omicronrg9.message: Oh! What a considerable reward! OK, OK. Only Feygard people are so generous!
I have to stay here to supervise my guards. They sometimes need educating about what to do. I assume you're able to escort her without problems?

replies.text: [Lie]For the glory of Feygard, I will!

conversationlist_omicronrg9.message: Oh, I see. Maybe you're right.
You again?!

replies.text: [Lie] Sorry, but I have to take you back home!

conversationlist_omicronrg9.message: No! I won't go anywhere with you, commoner! Guards, guards!
Haha! Sorry lady, but your father wants you back home. I also believe this dirty tavern is no place for a woman like you, haha!

replies.text: Yes, you have to come with me.

conversationlist_omicronrg9.message: NO! I've said no! Don't bother me. Get away from me!

replies.text: [Whispering] You fool! Be quiet. Listen to me if you want to save your life.

conversationlist_omicronrg9.message: (You tap her on the back of the head with the handle of your weapon, and she falls unconscious)

Halt! The road to Fallhaven is closed due to recent information about a dangerous criminal who has been seen not far from here.
That criminal committed a murder only hours ago.

replies.text: But I really need to pass!

conversationlist_omicronrg9.message:
Sorry, I'm not able to decide who passes. This barricade will be here until we catch or kill the criminal.

(You take a look into your map. There seems to be another way to reach Fallhaven, heading up to the North)

(You put Ambelie, who is still unconscious, in a chair next to you)

Oh! How did you get here so fast? I've heard reports of a barricade blocking the way from the Duleian road to Fallhaven.

replies.text: Barricades, guards ... no big thing for me.

conversationlist_omicronrg9.message: OK, well done. Now we will have to find a better place for our guest. Keeping this lady here could be dangerous for us.

replies.text: I'm sure that's the case, but that's not my problem anymore. Right?

conversationlist_omicronrg9.message: Yes it is.

replies.text: Well, I have no choice. What should I do?

conversationlist_omicronrg9.message: Hmm, let me think about it ....
We are supposed to have one room for receiving "visitors". However, I don't know if It's finished.
Hmm, I believe Troublemaker knows the actual state of that place. Ask him, and if it's possible leave our guest there.

replies.text: OK, I will. (You lift Ambelie up and carry her on your shoulders)
Hmpf ... Bye (You lift Ambelie up and carry her on your shoulders)

conversationlist_omicronrg9.message: So do you want to kill her quietly?

replies.text: No, just I want a suitable place to leave her until ...
What? No, I am just asking you for a place for this type of job. Umar told me you knew of somewhere.

conversationlist_omicronrg9.message: Yeah, the ransom. I'm a veteran kid, don't forget that.
Hmpf, be more specific next time. I'm not a mind-reader!
Well, I understand. Yes I have a place, but there's a problem. That place is at the other end of the town, next to the graveyard.

replies.text: I don't think that will present a major problem for me.
I got here without any problem. Why I would have problems crossing through town?

conversationlist_omicronrg9.message: Well, anyway, I'm building a way underground to reach it without being seen. It will be ready next time, I promise.

replies.text: Thank you. I will go there.

conversationlist_omicronrg9.message: OK. Make sure you're not seen doing suspicious things!
Yes, there is something.
I almost forgot. Take this key. Make sure you put it in correctly to open the hatchway.

replies.text: Hmm, OK. I will keep that in mind.

conversationlist_omicronrg9.message: I have better things to do than help an apprentice. Leave me. Hmpf.
Looking around the room, you see an unusual mechanism. A crowbar with a locked chain that prevents a lever from being moved.
You hit the chain, but all you get is a mark on your weapon and frustration, as the chain is still intact.
This is probably the place Troublemaker mentioned. You see a crowbar with a locked chain that surrounds the whole mechanism, stopping it from moving. The key seems to fit into the lock.

replies.text: Put the key into the lock.

conversationlist_omicronrg9.message:
You insert the key in the lock. You can hear strange noises and creaks as you turn the key. You make an extra effort, and finally the heavy chain falls on the floor, freeing the mechanism.

When you move the lever the floor starts trembling, and eventually a hatch appears that  leads downstairs.
This cell looks like the right place for a hostage.
You leave Ambelie in the cell and close the door.

Ah, yes ... that captive. Take this food and make sure she is comfortable enough. We don't want her starving right?
(Troublemaker gives you some bread)

replies.text: Argh. OK. What a tedious job!

conversationlist_omicronrg9.message: (Ambelie seems to be resting, dead to the world. The entire room is quiet. You really don't like this cold place)
(You take a look at the cell. Ambelie has awakened. When she looks at you, her face turns pale)

replies.text: Hello! I have food for you.
Hey, you! Take this food quickly, I have no time to waste!

conversationlist_omicronrg9.message: Wh..what do you want? What have you done to me? Where in the world am I? Answer me!

replies.text: That does not concern you. Take this food please.
Look, if you don't shut up I will silence you my own way, OK?

conversationlist_omicronrg9.message: Don't hurt me please! I will be quiet.

replies.text: Now take this food ... Without complaining!

conversationlist_omicronrg9.message: Food, you say?

replies.text: Are you deaf or something? Take this bread and stop bothering me!

conversationlist_omicronrg9.message: Bread? That's not a worthy food for a noblewoman like me! Oh my, where am I?

replies.text: If you prefer going without food in this ugly cell for a long while then I don't care.
Do you prefer to eat the floor, bad mannered woman?

conversationlist_omicronrg9.message: S..sorry, please ... Yes I'm hungry ... Will you give me that? *sniffs*
Th..thanks. Now, please tell me, where am I?

replies.text: Sorry, but I cannot reveal that to you right now. Bye.
That doesn't matter! If you behave well maybe you will be out of here sooner rather than later.

conversationlist_omicronrg9.message: ... Fine *sniffs*.
(You look again through the bars. Ambelie is still there, alive, and gnawing on the bread you gave her earlier.)
Excellent. From now on me and my fellows will take care of her.

replies.text: Very well. I will go and talk to Umar again. Bye.

conversationlist_omicronrg9.message: Do that.
Hey, what are you waiting for? Leave me and go talk with Umar or something!

replies.text: You don't need to be rude! I will leave.

conversationlist_omicronrg9.message: Simple. Talk with Troublemaker about this job. He probably knows of some safe place to keep her. Then return to me.
Fine .... Although you look odd. What's the matter?

replies.text: It's OK ... it's just that is not my kind of work.
Urgh ... I just need better tasks! Do you still think I'm not yet ready?

conversationlist_omicronrg9.message: Sometimes people must do things that they don't like. Maybe you're still too young to understand that?
No, nothing of the kind! I was .... Well, let's talk.
Well .... Anyway, I promise we won't give you those kind of jobs for a while.

replies.text: That is good news for me.

conversationlist_omicronrg9.message: Great, so let's talk then.
First of all, take this gold for a job well done. We have already sent people to ask for the ransom.

(Umar looks a little worried)

This is really not your line of work huh?
I suggest you rest for a while before doing more. You look tired.

replies.text: Tired? I don't know what that means!

conversationlist_omicronrg9.message: I prefer that you are completely rested before talking about work.
Don't be overconfident. Take my advice and rest. We'll talk tomorrow.

Come back to me when you're prepared. Bear in mind that your next task isn't going to be as easy as the ones you already did.
We'll talk about that tomorrow.

replies.text: I expected that. See you tomorrow then.
Easy? Argh, they've been so difficult! Good night.

conversationlist_omicronrg9.message: (You should go to the bed now. You take off your bag and grab the blanket. This bed is more comfortable than you thought, but maybe that's because you are really exhausted. Finally, you blow out the candle in the room.)
Umar was clear. Sleep, then return. I should do what he said and go to bed.

(The night here is anything but quiet. You can hear wolves' howls, as they become more active during the night. Even people's conversations can be overheard. However, you couldn't care less about that right now. You finally fall asleep)
(The sun rises and you open your eyes. You feel fully rested and eager to talk with Umar. He's probably waiting for you.)
I should not leave the city now. Father told me once that monsters and beasts are more dangerous at night.
Why am I heading in this direction? The tavern isn't in this way!
It would be better to not bother people at this hour.
I see you are better than yesterday.
Fine. Listen to me carefully.

replies.text: Sure, tell me what you have to say.

conversationlist_omicronrg9.message: Here in the guild, as you know, members range from apprentices to veterans. The veterans are usually specialized in specific jobs.
Troublemaker is my right hand man. He's in charge of planning jobs that have some level of complexity.
Pickpocket has developed his stealth skills to such an extreme that he's able to take your equipment, and you'll barely even feel it.
Each person has their own way to reach the top.
Believe me, I'm not lying.
Anyway, the fact is that one of our veterans has betrayed us.
Yes. He and his former comrades were sent to the Fallhaven catacombs.

replies.text: I thought the work there was done since I brought the key of Luthor to you.

conversationlist_omicronrg9.message: The key is just the first part. We need to decipher the runes in the key in order to reach the crypt.

replies.text: What crypt? I've never heard of it.

conversationlist_omicronrg9.message: The team leader and others loyal to him killed the rest of the team and escaped with the key, before entering the church. They have probably deciphered the code and they want to sell the information to the highest bidder. That happened three nights ago.
Let's just say that's not important to you at this moment. What they did is more important now.
Honestly, I don't know for certain.
Sure, I can do that.
Apparently they decided the Guild wasn't the best option, so they turned greedy and betrayed us. That's more common than I would like to admit.

replies.text: They have signed their own death sentence.

conversationlist_omicronrg9.message: There's more. Two days ago the southern route from here to the Duleian road was closed, because there was a murder. Soldiers are trying to prevent the murderer from escaping to the west.

replies.text: And you think the traitors are involved in that?

conversationlist_omicronrg9.message: I'm pretty sure about it. The team leader is the one we call "Crackshot", as he is a master of murder, torture and the subjugation arts. He's really a dangerous man.

replies.text: So, do you have a plan?
What am I supposed to do?

conversationlist_omicronrg9.message: Hmm ... I think we have no choice. We'll have to deal with him and his henchmen ... forever.

replies.text: OK, leave this to me. That's finally the kind of work I was searching for.
I ... I prefer to not get involved into this. Sorry.

conversationlist_omicronrg9.message: Are you completely sure? You will be alone against trained thieves and other criminals whose sole objective is to earn more and more gold.

replies.text: I can deal with them with my bare hands!

conversationlist_omicronrg9.message: Maybe it's not the best time. We must bring him down. Think about it. There are probably many lives at risk ...
Whatever, I do believe you are capable. Regardless, be cautious with Crackshot. He's powerful, and his attacks can severely wound or kill you. Clear?

replies.text: Bah, words are worth nothing now. It's going to be a nice fight.

conversationlist_omicronrg9.message: If you say so. Your self-confidence is a good aspect of your personality.
However, there's still a problem. We're not completely sure about the location of Crackshot's new hideout.

replies.text: What? How I will find him then?
He will show up sooner or later ...

conversationlist_omicronrg9.message: Probably people near the Duleian road guard tower know more. See if you can ask them for tips.
Maybe, but it will be faster if you question people near the Duleian road guard tower. The Duleian road is the place where we think he was last seen.

replies.text: Argh, the Duleian road is big!

conversationlist_omicronrg9.message: Sorry, I have no more information. If you need anything come back. Good luck.
That's why you have to ask.
Make sure you don't talk about the Guild and his relationship with us. Don't trust anyone.

replies.text: I won't even trust my shadow.

conversationlist_omicronrg9.message: Fine.
Remember, this is an important mission! Don't forget it again!
First, you must find Crackshot's hideout.
Then you will have to deal with him and his henchmen, and finally bring back the Key of Luthor to us.
Understood?

replies.text: Can you explain it to me again?

conversationlist_omicronrg9.message: Excellent. Good luck.

Are you serious?
Bah, I'll repeat it for you ...
Aren't you a bit young to be travelling around here all by yourself?

replies.text: Sorry, have you heard anything about a murder?

conversationlist_omicronrg9.message: Yeah, Feygard authorities have sent more patrols to the south. Apparently there is a group of criminals hiding in the forest
Now go away kid, I'm working!
(This man seems to be immersed in his thoughts)

replies.text: Hi. Have you heard about the murder not far from here?

conversationlist_omicronrg9.message:
What? A murder?
I don't know what you're talking about, sorry.

replies.text: Civilians! You never see anything. Bye.

conversationlist_omicronrg9.message: Sorry, kid! I'm unable to let you pass. Orders from above!
Yes. He's not alone!
Yes! We have sent patrols to the north. There's a place infested by larval burrowers.
He and the other criminals are probably hiding there!

Yes! Those crimin ...
Wait, you don't have to know this information! Forget everything I've said!
Halt! The road to Fallhaven is closed due to a murder committed three days ago.

replies.text: Hey! I live in Crossglen. How do you expect me to get there?

conversationlist_omicronrg9.message: (You look at the floor. The blood hasn't coagulated yet. It seems there has been a recent fight between two or more people.)
(The same blood stains. They are coagulating more and more. Soon they will be just another mark on the floor.)
(More blood. There's no doubt, there has been a fight here.)
(Looking again at the same blood marks won't achieve anything except wasted time.)

ARGH!! *sword clashing*

Sergeant! Sergeant!
... *laughter*

replies.text: That sounds like fighting nearby. I should check into that.

conversationlist_omicronrg9.message: (You see, horrified, how this man is bleeding out rapidly. He has countless cuts and his face is mutilated. You can almost hear his gasps.)

replies.text: For the glory of Feygard, you will be avenged!

conversationlist_omicronrg9.message: Sar...gent. *gasps*.

Y..you kid ... Argh! *spits up blood*.
That guy is not ... Argh.

No ... he's not .... Agggh!
[He has stopped breathing. I cannot do anything for him. Better to move on.]
(The terrible smell of blood here is unbearable. However, I should check whether those men are alive.)
No way. There are countless cobwebs. I should go through the door.
I think I should check those strange blood marks before going on ....

Another idiot trying to pass through here, eh?
Your life ends here!

replies.text: The people you've killed will be avenged.

conversationlist_omicronrg9.message:
(Gives you a surprised look). How ...?
Who are you kid?

Wait! That's not actually important.
Leave this dangerous place, right now!

replies.text: You are right. It would be better to leave.
Hah! No way, I won't give up.
I'm here because ... I'm here to help you!

conversationlist_omicronrg9.message: My whole patrol is dead! Why do you think you have any chance of success?

replies.text: I managed to reach this place. Is that not enough for you?
I'm not here to discuss that with you.

conversationlist_omicronrg9.message: It's your life, do whatever you want.

replies.text: Please tell me what do you know about the current situation.

conversationlist_omicronrg9.message: Indeed, I don't know why are you here!
I don't know much. Only that me and my patrol were sent here to arrest a murderer. But what we found was unexpected.
We reached these passages via a forest cavern, and went through the beasts without any major problem. Suddenly, the suspect appeared with a group of men, probably his allies or subordinates ...
Those people were fast. Very fast and very dangerous. They killed them! My fellows, all of them defeated!
I managed to get rid of most of them, but I'm severely wounded and unable to continue ...

Don't you understand? You must leave this place before you can't.

He's playing with us!

replies.text: You are right. I will leave.
Take these supplies and leave. I'll avenge your mates.
Don't worry. You must report this before it is too late. I'll go there instead of you.

conversationlist_omicronrg9.message: Agh, thank you. You are valiant, kid. I hope to see you when we are both out of here. I'll invite you for a drink!

replies.text: OK, thank you. Now I have to run.
Yeah, sounds good. For the glory of Feygard I'll avenge your mates!

conversationlist_omicronrg9.message: (You see a hole leading to a cave. Maybe this is a good place to start searching.)
Kid, why are you still here? Leave me, I'm just resting a bit.

replies.text: Don't be rude! I'm here to help you. Please leave and go to a safer place.
Calm down. Take these supplies and call backup!

conversationlist_omicronrg9.message: You couldn't be in a worse place to play hide and seek, kid. Die!

replies.text: Now your mates will play that with your corpse!

conversationlist_omicronrg9.message: Oh ho! Welcome to my base, kid.

replies.text: Hmm .... This is not the place where I would choose to live.
You are under arrest for the crimes you've committed against Feygard!

conversationlist_omicronrg9.message: Haven't you realized yet? Your life is not going to be much longer.

replies.text: Hah! Let's see if you're as strong as Umar has said.

conversationlist_omicronrg9.message: *laugh* Are you serious?
Do you really believe such words are worth anything here?
Let's see if you can arrest me after I have finished with you!

replies.text: The Feygard soldiers will be avenged!
Your head will serve as proof!

conversationlist_omicronrg9.message: The lock seems to match with the key of Luthor.

replies.text: Insert the key of Luthor into the lock.
Insert the blessed key of Luthor into the lock.

conversationlist_omicronrg9.message: W..wait ....

(The dying Crackshot is in agony. He looks at you despairingly)
It is curs...sed.
The key is cursed .... She ... I am ... (Crackshot finally dies, emitting a soft bluish breath)

replies.text: Bah .... Too many questions. I need to come back.

conversationlist_omicronrg9.message: Excellent. Did he have the key with him?

replies.text: Yes ... [give key]. Why is this key so important to us?
Sure, here, take it. And maybe it's time to give me some more information.
He had the key, but I don't have it with me.

conversationlist_omicronrg9.message: Don't try to fool me. I am Umar. I know you have it.

replies.text: Oh. Yes, I remember now that I found the key. Here, take it.
Even if I have the key, I won't give it to you.

conversationlist_omicronrg9.message: Why did it take so long? And do not look at me that way. I can not tell you anything about the key for now.
Come back when you are sane again.
Then what you are waiting for? Go and get it!
I'm sorry, but for now I can't say more.
Be patient, my friend. Everything will come in due time.

replies.text: I expect my patience will be rewarded.

conversationlist_omicronrg9.message: Anyway, you've done your work. My spies reported to me that you saved someone's life.

replies.text: If your spies help me, tasks would be easier.
Yeah. He was a Feygard officer ... a sergeant I think.

conversationlist_omicronrg9.message: Anyway, you've done your work. My spies reported to me you had saved someone's life.

replies.text: If your spies help me, tasks would be easier.
I tried to, unfortunately he didn't survive. But it was nobody important.
No, he died at last. He was a Feygard officer ... a sergeant I think.

conversationlist_omicronrg9.message: Trust me, it will.
I've told you to have patience, my friend. Any thief is dead without patience.
I mean this is not the time to tell you what you want to know, sorry.
Each of you have your own specific task. Spies must hide their identities, even to their allies.
I see ....
Hmm! And now to business. Here's your reward for the good work.

Take {4000} gold coins, and some bottles of my favorite mead.
Now you deserve a good rest, my friend. You have earned the trust of the Thieves' Guild.

replies.text: Count me in for the next job.

conversationlist_omicronrg9.message: I will, no doubt about it.
And last but not least, I have some useful information for you. The way from here to the southeast has finally been opened, once Crackshot's hideout was discovered.

replies.text: Good, I'm not going to have to take that detour.
Thank you for the information. Bye.

conversationlist_omicronrg9.message: However, the Feygard presence is still significant. Be cautious with what you do.

replies.text: I will, thank you for the advice.

conversationlist_omicronrg9.message: No jobs today my young friend. Maybe some other day.

replies.text: That's a shame. Find more time for my skills then.

conversationlist_omicronrg9.message: [Here, the story continues]
Wha... what are you referring to?

replies.text: Sorry. Time to sleep! (Knock her out)
I'm here to detain you, and then ask for a ransom.

conversationlist_omicronrg9.message: No way! Guards!

replies.text: I'm not going to hurt you, I don't want to do this.

conversationlist_omicronrg9.message: You! Don't go any further. Leave me!

replies.text: I'm not going to hurt you.

conversationlist_omicronrg9.message: I couldn't care less about you! Just ask the guards.

replies.text: Those untrained men aren't able to defend themselves. Don't make me laugh.
Other people will get you, and they won't be as kind as me.

conversationlist_omicronrg9.message: I am safe here!

replies.text: You aren't, and my presence here is the proof!

conversationlist_omicronrg9.message: Then get out of my sight now!

replies.text: I can't.Things are not that easy! Other people will get you instead of me.
They will probably kill me if I go back without you.

conversationlist_omicronrg9.message: Stop. Then tell me what I can do!

replies.text: Give me something of value, and you won't see me again.
[Lie]I have enough gold, so if you give me something valuable .... The ransom we were going to ask will be covered.

conversationlist_omicronrg9.message: Take this and leave me, please.

replies.text: It has been a pleasure, my lady.

conversationlist_omicronrg9.message: I see guilt in your eyes, my young friend.

replies.text: I couldn't accomplish the objective, I'm sorry.
I felt sorry for that woman, and I decided to extort her and get the gold directly.

conversationlist_omicronrg9.message: You don't need to tell me things I can see with my own eyes, it is a waste of time.
I expect more of you. That was your first mission inside the guild and you failed it!

replies.text: I brought a valuable necklace from the noblewoman.

conversationlist_omicronrg9.message: Being a good liar is a very valuable ability for the guild, but useless against me.
What we have here? (Umar's face gets a smile while he admires the necklace)
Well. I will take it as compensation for your mistakes.
You already took my necklace. Leave me alone.
You already triggered the lever that opened a hatch which leads downstairs.

You ... Argh ... 
[The sergeant takes one final breath and then dies. You should have come earlier. Now you will never get to know what he wanted to tell you.]
The door opens.
Something prevents the key from turning, so you cannot unlock the door.
I'm afraid all the beds at the guild are taken for the night. We have arrangements at the inn in town though. If you tell them Umar sent you then you will not have to pay for a bed.
No jobs today my young friend. Maybe some other day.

replies.text: That's a shame. Find more time for my skills then.

conversationlist_omicronrg9.message: You are really very hardworking. I can't find new work for you fast enough. You're free for now.
Yes, I do have a new task for you. So, listen to me carefully.
Here in the guild, as you know, income sources come in different classes from poor to wealthy. The lower-middle class and poor class are usually associated with us.
Wealthy class is our highest target. This is why I didn't doubt to give you the first mission to kidnap Ambelie for ransom.

replies.text: That is not my kind of work though.

conversationlist_omicronrg9.message: Don't worry, we already made a promise.
Anyway, the rest of the class are either with us or against us.
Most of the time we made deals and negotiations with them in exchange of peace or protection.
One of them is the popular brewery town called 'Sullengard' located far to the south of Vilegard.

replies.text: What makes the place interesting for us?

conversationlist_omicronrg9.message: They have a massive bootleg brewery operation because Feygard is unfairly taxing them.
As a result, they asked us to help them. We even have 80/20 share of their business.
No. 80 for them and 20 for us.
Their 20th anniversary beer festival will be celebrated in the next few weeks.

replies.text: I didn't know that I was invited.
But I'm not interested in beer.

conversationlist_omicronrg9.message: Don't worry. Even your brother was a helping hand in Sullengard. I'm sure you can do the same as well.

replies.text: He didn't even invite me either.
So you want me to go there?

conversationlist_omicronrg9.message: I want you to go to Sullengard and find one of my appointed veterans named Defy.
Tell him that it is time to give the bootleg brewers their share to aid in their livelihoods. Especially in paying their taxes.

replies.text: But I need an invitation letter first.
I'll just wait for my brother to do that because it's very far.

conversationlist_omicronrg9.message: Hurry now. There's no time to waste.
Not again. What's on his mind?

replies.text: I'll ask him again once his head is cool.

conversationlist_omicronrg9.message: Sigh. He may be stubborn sometimes but he is a great supervisor. You should ask him once he is calm.

replies.text: I'm going to visit him again. Bye.

conversationlist_omicronrg9.message: He can't be gone without our share from the bootleg brewers.

replies.text: I thought he would come back here.

conversationlist_omicronrg9.message: Go back to Sullengard and ask the townspeople if they know of his whereabouts.

replies.text: I'm on my way back to Sullengard now. Bye.

conversationlist_omicronrg9.message: This is madness! He betrayed us just like Crackshot did.

replies.text: We better find and kill him and his men and retrieve the share to help the people of Sullengard.

conversationlist_omicronrg9.message: Yes. We must find and kill them and retrieve the share for the sake of Sullengard's living.
Fortunately, one of my men found one of his drunk men and had a short talk with him before he bled to death.
He said that they will no longer be a part of the Thieves' Guild. They are now referring to themselves as 'Aidem'.

replies.text: What a weird name. For what reason?

conversationlist_omicronrg9.message: They prefer riches over honor.
Such a dishonorable act for they stole {50000} gold coins including the treasures of Sullengard.

replies.text: Their dishonorable act will be their undoing.

conversationlist_omicronrg9.message: We still don't know where they are.
Sullengard is our friend. Find a way to earn gold.

replies.text: How can we earn that large amount of gold?
This requires so much gold, how can we earn it?

conversationlist_omicronrg9.message: I trust that you will find a way. In the meantime, go back to Sullengard and give them the share we promised them so they can go on with their lives.
Here's {1000} gold coins as my financial contribution.
Immediately report back to me once you are done.

replies.text: I better start looking for gold now.

conversationlist_omicronrg9.message: Good job, kid! I knew I could count on you. Here, take this blade. It used to be your brother's.

replies.text: Thank you, sir. You can count me in as well to kill Defy.
Thank you sir, but what about Defy and his men?

conversationlist_omicronrg9.message: Like I said, we are still looking for him. You should rest for now from your long haul.

replies.text: You're right. My legs are so tired from having to walk back and forth from here to Sullengard so many times.
Yes, I should rest from my long travel.

conversationlist_omicronrg9.message: Andor, is that you? You grew weak and small. How was your visit to Nor City?

replies.text: I'm $playername. Andor is my brother and I'm not weak.

conversationlist_omicronrg9.message: Oh, yeah, but you do look a lot like him. I'm Defy.

replies.text: So you know my brother as well?

conversationlist_omicronrg9.message: Indeed. He always asks questions like a curious kid does. Tell me, what brings you here, $playername?

replies.text: Umar told me that it is time to give their share to the bootleg brewers.
Umar sent me for our business.

conversationlist_omicronrg9.message: The time of sharing? If that's so, then tell him that there will be a delay.
Just mind your own business, kid. Now, get out of here or I'll kick you out.

replies.text: You will be the one who's kicked out of here.
You will be the one to blame here.

conversationlist_omicronrg9.message: Strange. Defy and his men are gone. Maybe they talked with the bootleg brewers here and reported back to Umar?

conversationlist_arulir_mountain.message: You have a gut feeling that it would be better to not go any further unprepared.
You need some item that would help you go through there undiscovered.
The Bridge is broken. It would not hold your weight.
The ground under your feet suddenly gives way, a fissure opens, and you fall into it.

replies.text: Good thing I put on these protective boots. Who knows what could have happened otherwise!

conversationlist_arulir_mountain.message: Again, a crack has opened and you fall into it.

replies.text: My protective boots saved my life another time!
I almost broke my legs. I wish I had better shoes...

conversationlist_arulir_mountain.message: Another hole in the ground! This time you can't even see the bottom, but somehow you managed to stop your fall after a few meters.

replies.text: I have to remember to thank Bernhar for the boots!
It is really dangerous to walk here!

conversationlist_arulir_mountain.message:
Some rocks above your head begin to crack.
A moment later a pile of rocks rains down on you.

replies.text: Thanks to my protective cap I am not seriously hurt.

conversationlist_arulir_mountain.message:
You hear rocks cracking above your head again.
There is no chance to jump away before they hit!

replies.text: Good thing I am wearing this protective cap!
I should take more care where I am going!

conversationlist_arulir_mountain.message: You fell into another hole hidden in the ground and hurt yourself.

replies.text: I hope my boots are OK.

conversationlist_arulir_mountain.message: Rocks falling! You jump aside - luckily a very big boulder only grazed your side.

replies.text: That was neat. I fear that not even my protective cap would have helped much against that huge boulder.

conversationlist_arulir_mountain.message: A huge boulder suddenly breaks, and its pieces fall down from above onto you.

replies.text: Thanks to my protective cap I am not seriously hurt.

conversationlist_arulir_mountain.message: You fell into a hole and hurt yourself.

replies.text: Will these holes in the ground never end?

conversationlist_arulir_mountain.message: Several small but sharp edged pieces of rock are coming down. One hits you right on the top of your head.

replies.text: That could have been very bad without my cap!
Ouch! It's like the mountain is out to get me!

conversationlist_arulir_mountain.message:
A big part of the mountain side above you cracks.
A moment later a pile of rocks rains down on you.

replies.text: Ouch! It could have been worse though, without the cap!

conversationlist_arulir_mountain.message: You fell into yet another hole and hurt yourself.

replies.text: Good footwear is a prerequisite for successful exploration!
I'm really starting to hate this place!

conversationlist_arulir_mountain.message: Guess what - you have found another crack in the ground.

replies.text: [singing] How many holes must a man fall down...?

conversationlist_arulir_mountain.message:
Seven rocks above your head begin to crack.
A moment later a pile of rocks rains down on you.

replies.text: *Sigh* Even with the protective cap, these rocks are really annoying!

conversationlist_arulir_mountain.message: You stumble over some rocks. As you fall against the wall, it buckles and the whole wall begins to crumble.
When the dust clears a bit you can see a small corridor.
The ground is very slippery. You can't get back onto the solid rock!
You slide slowly into the cold water ... you think of Mikhail, and of Andor ... your senses disappear ...
Shivering you come back to consciousness. The current has taken you a long way, but fortunately you have been washed ashore.
The lava is bubbling and glowing flakes are scorching through your clothes.
Danger! Unstable cliffs. Proceed with caution!
Danger! Cave subject to rockfall. Do not enter!
Oh - a wandering kid! How surprising!
My name is Bernhar. I am an explorer, and I'm trying to find out something about the cave system here.

replies.text: Ah. Interesting. Keep having fun with it. Bye.

conversationlist_arulir_mountain.message: Oh - the wandering kid! You are still alive? How surprising!

replies.text: Hi Bernhar. I want to talk with you again.

conversationlist_arulir_mountain.message: Sure! I could tell you things...
Steep mountain flanks and wide, branching, cave passages! But beware - it is dangerous ground! You must not go unprotected!
You are not taking me seriously. Let me tell you...
You are risking your life here. It is not only those Arulir brutes. They are just annoying.
The ground is really dangerous. It's deceptive and life-threatening. And there is always the danger of falling rocks from above.
I was only able to survive this far because I was wearing the proper protective gear.
I have completed my work here though, so I don't need it any more. I could sell it to you for a good price.
If you go in there unprotected, I fear there will be no other time.
Hey kid! The protective gear is of no use if you don't wear it!

replies.text: Oh, yes. Thank you for reminding me!

conversationlist_arulir_mountain.message: Oh, what a rare surprise!

replies.text: What are you doing in such a lonely place?
I'm surprised to see you here as well. Did you order 'Mysterious green something'?

conversationlist_arulir_mountain.message: I am Tjure of Brimhaven. I am ... was ... a successful merchant. But my luck has run out.
All I can do now is hide in this lonely place, far away from any water.

replies.text: Aha. I won't bother you then.

conversationlist_arulir_mountain.message: I once found a mermaid asleep on the beach of a river, north of here. What a beautiful sight! I could not avert my eyes!
Especially, the colorful tail attracted me so much, that I did something that I have deeply regretted since then.
I pulled out one of her shimmering, dazzling scales, and ran away.
The mermaid immediately awoke and was very angry. But on land she had no chance to catch me.
Crying and sobbing, the mermaid called after me. Finally, she screamed at me that I would never find peace, and that I would never want to approach water again!
At first I was happy with my shimmering scale. But I soon realized that everything in my life was going wrong.
I couldn't think of anything else but the wrath of the people of the river.
What could I do? I tried to throw it away or give it to other people - all in vain.

I traveled all over Dhayavar to find someone to help me. Finally, a wise woman, far in the northeast, listened to my story. She advised me to return the scale to the mermaid. This would break the curse.
But I did not dare to do this.
She told me that my only other option was to find some kind-hearted person to buy it from me, but then they take on the curse.

replies.text: Let me be the one to rescue you. Sell me the scale.

conversationlist_arulir_mountain.message: I know, I know. When they heard my story, everybody ran away.

replies.text: That's too bad. I hope that you will find someone to buy it. Bye.
Not me. I will buy the scale.

conversationlist_arulir_mountain.message: So you really won't help me? You will leave me to my misery?

replies.text: Sorry, I can't do it. Bye.
I have to think about it.
OK. maybe I am stupid, but sell me the scale.

conversationlist_arulir_mountain.message: Here, take it! I have to request gold for it, otherwise it won't work. But one piece of gold should be enough.

replies.text: No problem, here, take the gold.

conversationlist_arulir_mountain.message: (As soon as you take the scale in your hands, a great sluggishness and a feeling of despair come over you.)
(For a second you feel very dizzy. At least you manage not to faint. As from afar you hear a voice.)
*Sigh* You were my last hope. Leave me now.

replies.text: OK. One question before I go: did you order a 'Mysterious green something'?

conversationlist_arulir_mountain.message: Thank you for your help.

replies.text: No problem. By the way, did you order a 'Mysterious green something'?

conversationlist_arulir_mountain.message: Oh, you look better than the last time we met. Thank you for your help.

replies.text: Indeed. By the way, did you order a 'Mysterious green something'?

conversationlist_arulir_mountain.message: This seems to be a very strange place. Maybe even dangerous.

replies.text: * Put the scale on the ground *

conversationlist_arulir_mountain.message: What a relief! You suddenly feel lighthearted again.
Suddenly, you hear someone singing.
You never heard such a beautiful sound before.
You found a heavy bag of gold. {1000} shining pieces of gold!
You have found a small, shiny, metal bar.
You feel that you can no longer hold on. You will have to slide into the cold water ...
You think of Mikhail, and of Andor ... your strength is slowly leaving you. ...
Maybe the current will wash you ashore somewhere?
The ground over there is very slippery. You don't want to fall into the water again.

conversationlist_burhczyd.message: Hi, who are you? I have never seen you here.

replies.text: My name is $playername. I am from Crossglen.
My father always told me not to talk to strangers.

conversationlist_burhczyd.message: Cool. I am Burhczyd afgz Dtaloumiye. Nice to meet you.

replies.text: Burh... - eh, OK. Do you live here in this town?

conversationlist_burhczyd.message: Yes. At least until now. My parents gave me some money so that I could tour the world. This morning I set off, and I'm staying here in the inn. However, I will have to earn some more money, otherwise it will be a short trip.

replies.text: Yes, some gold always helps. Hmm, maybe you can kill two birds with one stone.

conversationlist_burhczyd.message: What are you talking about?

replies.text: Take a cart and start a transport company. You can deliver goods to different cities and get some money.

conversationlist_burhczyd.message: Wow, splendid idea! I will take my father's cart. Then all I need is a name for my company. Thanks for this tip.
I am still thinking about what to call my company. As soon as I have a name, I'll start.
Hi, we know each other! Unfortunately I forgot your name. Come, have a drink with me. How are you?

replies.text: My name is $playername. And you are called something with Brr, as far as I can remember.

conversationlist_burhczyd.message: Yes, almost: My name is Burhczyd afgz Dtaloumiye. I opened a transport company, as you suggested.

replies.text: Great to hear! Is it going well? Do you already have many customers?

conversationlist_burhczyd.message: Well, there are not too many yet.
More precisely, none at all.
I have no idea. My beautiful cart with BURHCZYD AFGZ DTALOUMIYE - TRANSPORTS written in big white letters always runs empty.

replies.text: Good grief! What did you name your company?!

conversationlist_burhczyd.message: 'Burhczyd afgz Dtaloumiye - Transports'. Is there a problem with that?

replies.text: Nobody can pronounce that name, let alone remember it. No wonder you do not get any orders!

conversationlist_burhczyd.message: Do you really think so?

replies.text: Sure. You have to use a short and catchy name.

conversationlist_burhczyd.message: OK, I'll think about a better company name.
I am still thinking about a better name for my company. As soon as I have it, I'll leave.
Hello ... eh, sorry, I forgot your name. How are you?
Don't ask. Still no orders. And I have no idea why.

replies.text: That's horrible! What did you call your company? It should be short and memorable.

conversationlist_burhczyd.message: Yes, that's what I've done. You said 'Burhczyd afgz Dtaloumiye' was be too long and hard to remember, so I simply chose the initials of my name. Clever, right?
It is now: 'B.A.D. TRANSPORTS' - it looks great!

replies.text: You can't be serious!  BAD TRANSPORTS? Tell me that's just a joke!

conversationlist_burhczyd.message: Oh no! Did I get it wrong again? Nothing I do ever works. (sob)

replies.text: Look, just call your company 'Easy Transports'. That will do.

conversationlist_burhczyd.message: OK, thank you. I'll try. Later. Tomorrow. Maybe. (sob)
Only one more beer, then I'll leave.
Hello, what's-your-name? How are you?

replies.text: I am fine. And my name is $playername, as you should know by now.

conversationlist_burhczyd.message: I am Burhczyd afgz Dtaloumiye, proud owner of Easy Transports.

replies.text: The last time we saw each other, you did not have any transport orders yet.

conversationlist_burhczyd.message: Oh, that has completely changed. I am into big business now.
I just got a cartload of fresh fish in Remgard. I think I will sell it here with a high profit.
In the last two cities, they could not afford to buy this quality fish. But it will work here. Certainly.
Of course from Remgard, their fish is the best - a rare delicacy in this area!
What?

replies.text: Nothing. Because we have known each other for so long, I will suggest something.

conversationlist_burhczyd.message: Fire away. Your ideas are always good.

replies.text: I will buy your fish for, say, {1000} gold pieces.

conversationlist_omi2.message: Hello child, if you came to climb the mountain here, then I have to disappoint you.

The ladder is under construction.

Under all the rotten food, there is a long vine all rolled up. It might be useful, so you decide to take it.
You have already plundered the basket.
You find a hole next to a large rock which seems well attached to the ground.

replies.text: Maybe I should look around here or a little further up the mountain?
Tie the vine to the rock.

Haha. This rock looks like my brother Andor. 
I think I've been on the trail too long... I'm going crazy.

conversationlist_omi2.message: If I could find something like a rope, I could use it to lower myself into that hole.
Once tied, you give the improvised rope a couple of firm tugs. It seems stable enough to help you climb down the hole.
Attention villagers: Climbing the mountain has been prohibited due to the recent tragic events. All mountain patrol crews have been disbanded until further notice.
This must be the remains of some imprudent villager who ventured into the mountain despite the warnings. There are signs of a former camp down the mountain.
Nothing interesting here.
You have already looked at this corpse.
There's certainly nothing but rotten flesh and bones here.
You see a corpse, much more decomposed than the one you saw on the hillside, and wrapped up in cobwebs. What kind of spider would be able to do such a thing?
A second after you break the cobweb, a bunch of small spiders emerge from the corpse. Some of them climb up your arm and bite you before you shake them off.

replies.text: Ugh, great. This one had nothing but ugly spiders.
*looking at the corpse*. Poor man, no match for a couple of arachnids... Rest in peace.

conversationlist_omi2.message: Yet another corpse in the same state as the previous one. One of its legs seems violently fractured.
That is certainly not a wound one of these spiders would cause. There's something strange about all this.
This one is the most decayed of all corpses you saw here. Who are these people?

replies.text: Rest in peace, whoever you were. (Leave it be)
*looking at the dead body* Well, I don't think you need your belongings anymore, right? (Plunder the corpse)

conversationlist_omi2.message: YOU! We will pursue you for your crimes!
There's nothing but rotten flesh and bones here.
You don't feel good in this room. Something is utterly wrong here.
Keep looking around.
You throw another quick glance at the blood-stained chair. What a horrible scene.
One of the chairs is moved apart from the rest. There are dried blood stains all over it. A blood-stained rope rests next to the chair.
Someone has been tortured here, no doubt about it.
After several minutes of careful but fruitless search, you decide to take one of the ropes as evidence of the torture.
The very few rays of light that barely illuminate this small tunnel get lost in the inmense darkness of this hole.
There's neither ropes nor vines that could help you to go down. Furthermore, you can not figure out how far away the floor is.

replies.text: Drop a pebble down the hole.
Try to find another way down.

conversationlist_omi2.message: Nothing happens.

You should not waste any more time here. There are more urgent things to do.
The path along the water's edge narrows here. Peering down the tunnel, it appears the stream ends abruptly in what seems to be a waterfall. After that, there's just darkness.
It is definitely not a good idea to keep going this way without any reason.

There's nothing written here anymore. The wood is rotten, dried, and cracked, the borders of the sign are eroded and a dense layer of grime covers its top. 
It must have been ages since someone put it here.
Damn it, kid! Watch your step. You almost knocked me over!

replies.text: Sorry, I am in a hurry.

conversationlist_omi2.message: Umm, what's the matter?

replies.text: As I said, I don't have time to talk. I need to report something important.
Nothing of your concern. I must go inside.

conversationlist_omi2.message: Not only blind but bad-mannered too! You remind me of myself when I was younger. I was not blind, though, ha ha ha!

replies.text: I don't trust you with something this important, so nothing.

conversationlist_omi2.message: I see. But keep in mind that no one inside there will pay attention to you, whatever you say.
Have you? *He gets closer*

OK, kid. Do it, and I'll wait here for your return, heh. By the way, my name is Ehrenfest.
This is no place for kids.

replies.text: I will report your bad manners to your chief.

conversationlist_omi2.message: Yeah, we already know about the gornauds.

replies.text: Hmpf, when the gornauds get the village surrounded I'll be the one babysitting all of you.

conversationlist_omi2.message: Yes. They seem to be learning from every attack and their numbers are increasing.

replies.text: Will you hear what I have to say then?

conversationlist_omi2.message: Of course you can. Go back home and let me and the rest do our job. Understood?

replies.text: Whatever, you won't stand up after a Gornaud blow.

conversationlist_omi2.message: The guard is mumbling something to himself and seems to be ignoring you completely.
In front of you, some guys seem to be hearing carefully or rather gingerly a charismatic voice.
I am a very reasonable man, but the problems between this village and Blackwater settlement have delayed the tax collection of this region.
Taxes are the solid pillar that maintain our and your lands. Other villages will rightly complain if we continue to allow this without repercussions.
With all due respect, general, our problems here are wider and more complex than a simple disagreement with the people of Blackwater Settlement.

Yes...The mines are closed due to lack of workers. We are scarce of resources and isolated from the rest of the world because of the collapsed tunnels. Moreover, monster attacks are increasing in frequency and proximity to the village.
Yeah, yeah. I'm aware of the current situation.
So, first of all, I will leave some of my men here to reinforce the village. They are reliable ... Most of them at least.
Then I will travel to Blackwater Settlement. In the meanwhile, you must think about this offer:
Feygard will consider that the villagers of Prim will have fulfilled and exceeded their duties to the kingdom if - and only if - Prim leaves the full management of the mines to the capital.
What?! You can't...!
HOW DARE YOU INTERRUPT THE GENERAL?!
A palpable tension falls over the room as the guards begin to shout.
Calm down, all of you. Where is your temperance, soldiers of the glorious Feygard?
I am leaving now. You have a few days to think about it, but I'm afraid this is the best solution. Feygard will also take charge of rebuilding and cleaning the mines if you accept.
[The guard seems to be barely surpressing his anger.] We will truly consider your proposal. Best of luck in your travels, general.
I'm on duty, youngster. Go play somewhere else.

replies.text: Hah! Good one. Go buy a better sword, rookie.

conversationlist_omi2.message: Bah! I said I AM ON DUTY!

replies.text: Of course it is. I am sometimes out there.

conversationlist_omi2.message: Ha ha! Hilarious, but seriously be careful out there.

replies.text: OK, sir. Thank you for the advice.

conversationlist_omi2.message: Hey kid! Can you do me a favor?

replies.text: Have you seen my brother Andor? He looks a bit like me.

replies.text: No, he is not. But thanks anyway.

conversationlist_omi2.message: Well. Do you mind bringing me some food? I have not eaten anything decent since we arrived in this village.

conversationlist_omi2.message: Oh, looks good! Thank you, kid. Here's something shiny I've found.

replies.text: Oh! Thank you. Good luck in your duties.

replies.text: Anything for the glory of Feygard!

conversationlist_omi2.message: And good-mannered too! Keep going like this.

conversationlist_omi2.message: Oh yes. Good speakers with poison in their tongues. They conspire with the savages of the South against our righteous lord, just for restoring order in the wake of the chaos left after the war.

conversationlist_omi2.message: Your friends of the Shadow are not trustworthy. This is the best advice I can give you.

replies.text: May the Shadow not be with you, then.

conversationlist_omi2.message: Whatever, kid. My shift is ending and I don't like your tone. You will see that I am right when you get older.

replies.text: I won't waste my time anymore with a closed-minded Feygard soldier. Bye.
I did not want to offend you... Sorry.

conversationlist_omi2.message: Maybe you are right...But it's the duty of the shepherd to rid the flock of those black sheep.

replies.text: Is your general a good shepherd?

conversationlist_omi2.message: Absolutely. He is the smartest and strongest man I ever had the honor to meet and serve.

replies.text: I bet he won't survive the wyrms.
I think I will leave you and your fanaticism.

conversationlist_omi2.message: HOW DARE YOU?!
About to end for me. The people of this village are exaggerating. There aren't so many monsters, they are just weak.
These gornauds are no match for us, soldiers of the great Feygard.

replies.text: Sure. How many have you killed?

conversationlist_omi2.message: Heh, you have a point there, kid.

replies.text: Have you seen anything out of the normal?
Do you mind selling me some of your shiny armor? You know, I need protection.

conversationlist_omi2.message: Well...I...Actually, I should not be talking with you during my patrol. Leave me now.
I can't really. Guard patrolling tends to be boring work, but someone has to do it.

replies.text: I see. Hope you finish it soon, sir.
Have you found anything...for me to play with?

conversationlist_omi2.message: Your protection inside the village is granted by us. A kid like you does not need armor, but some friends to play with.

replies.text: Tell me some interesting story to tell my friends then. Did something happen during your round?

conversationlist_omi2.message: Thank you, kid.

replies.text: Sure, let me have a look.

conversationlist_omi2.message: I might even have some shiny gems...
Out of my sight kid. I'm on duty.

This is not a good place to talk about this. But trust me, there is much at stake and Prim's situation is only going to get worse. Let me introduce myself. My name is Ehrenfest, and...
OUT OF THE WAY, COMMONERS!
You and Ehrenfest are startled, and step aside. Three men with Feygard insignia leave the hall. You remain silent as they pass.
I will say it only once. No taverns, no exploring, no drama with those untrained Prim guards. And for the glory of our homeland, don't pursue any injured monster.
I have a bad feeling about all this. These villagers might be hiding something. Tell the mountain scouts to wait for me at the tunnel entrance. They will escort me up to Blackwater Settlement.
Yes, my general.
The three men continue on their way out of the village, completely ignoring your presence.
*looks nervous*  I told you. Something big is about to happen. I believe it is somehow related to what you've seen up in the mountain.

replies.text: How did they reach this place?

conversationlist_omi2.message: I assume the same way you did.
